title.zh: 卷六十一 志第十四 五行一上
title.raw: 卷六十一 志第十四 五行一上 Volume 61 Treatises 14: Five Elements 1a

sentences.zh: 天以陰陽五行化生萬物，盈天地之間，無非五行之妙用。

translations.literal: Heaven, by means of yin and yang and the five phases, generates and transforms the myriad things; filling the space between heaven and earth, there is nothing that is not the wondrous operation of the five phases.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven employs yin and yang and the five phases to generate and transform the myriad things; throughout the realm between heaven and earth, nothing escapes the subtle working of the five phases.

sentences.zh: 人得陰陽五行之氣以爲形，形生神知而五性動，五性動而萬事出，萬事出而休咎生。

translations.literal: Humans receive the qi of yin and yang and the five phases to form their bodies; from the body spirit and awareness arise and the five natures are stirred; when the five natures stir, the myriad affairs emerge; when the myriad affairs emerge, fortune and calamity are born.
translations.idiomatic: Human beings take on physical form by receiving the qi of yin and yang and the five phases; form gives rise to spirit and awareness, the five natures are set in motion, the myriad affairs come forth, and with them fortune and calamity.

sentences.zh: 和氣致祥，乖氣致異，莫不於五行見之。

translations.literal: Harmonious qi brings auspiciousness; perverse qi brings strangeness—all are seen in the five phases.
translations.idiomatic: Harmonious qi brings good omens, discordant qi brings anomalies, and all of this is manifest in the five phases.

sentences.zh: 《中庸》：「至誠之道，可以前知。

translations.literal: The Doctrine of the Mean: "The way of utmost sincerity can enable foreknowledge.
translations.idiomatic: The Doctrine of the Mean says: "The way of utmost sincerity makes foreknowledge possible.

sentences.zh: 國家將興，必有禎祥；

translations.literal: When a state is about to rise, there must be auspicious signs;
translations.idiomatic: When a state is about to flourish, auspicious signs will appear;

sentences.zh: 國家將亡，必有妖孽。

translations.literal: when a state is about to perish, there must be portents of evil.
translations.idiomatic: when it is about to fall, evil portents will appear.

sentences.zh: 見乎蓍龜，動乎四體。

translations.literal: They appear in the milfoil and tortoise, and stir in the four limbs.
translations.idiomatic: They show themselves in divination by milfoil and tortoise shell, and stir in the movements of the four limbs.

sentences.zh: 禍福將至，善必先知之，不善必先知之。」

translations.literal: When fortune or calamity is about to arrive, if it is good one will know it beforehand; if it is not good one will know it beforehand."
translations.idiomatic: When fortune or disaster is on the way, one who is virtuous will know it in advance, and one who is not will know it in advance as well."

sentences.zh: 人之一身，動作威儀，猶見休咎，人君以天地萬物爲體，禎祥妖孽之致，豈無所本乎？

translations.literal: In a single human body, in movement and bearing, fortune and calamity can still be seen; the ruler takes heaven, earth, and the myriad things as his body—can the arrival of auspicious signs and evil portents be without root?
translations.idiomatic: Even in a single person's bearing and conduct, fortune and calamity may be discerned. If the ruler takes heaven, earth, and the myriad things as his own body, must not auspicious signs and evil portents likewise have their source?

sentences.zh: 故由漢以來，作史者皆志五行，所以示人君之戒深矣。

translations.literal: Therefore from the Han onward, those who compiled histories all recorded the five phases, thereby showing how deep is the warning to rulers.
translations.idiomatic: That is why historians since the Han have all included treatises on the five phases—to show how grave is the warning meant for rulers.

sentences.zh: 自宋儒周惇頤《太極圖說》行世，儒者之言五行，原於理而究於誠。

translations.literal: Since the Song scholar Zhou Dunyi's Explanation of the Diagram of the Supreme Ultimate circulated in the world, Confucian discourse on the five phases has traced back to principle and pursued utmost sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhou Dunyi's Explanation of the Diagram of the Supreme Ultimate gained currency among Song Confucians, their discussions of the five phases rooted themselves in principle and sought their fulfillment in sincerity.

sentences.zh: 其于《洪範》五行五事之學，雖非所取，然班固、范曄志五行已推本之，及歐陽修《唐志》，亦采其說，且於庶征惟述災眚，而休祥闕焉，亦豈無所見歟？

translations.literal: As for the learning of the five phases and five affairs in the Hongfan, although they did not adopt it, yet Ban Gu and Fan Ye, in their treatises on the five phases, already traced matters back to it; when Ouyang Xiu compiled the Tang Annals, he too adopted their account, and in the various signs he described only disasters and calamities while omitting auspicious signs—was this not also a considered view?
translations.idiomatic: They did not embrace the Hongfan doctrine of the five phases and five affairs, yet Ban Gu and Fan Ye had already grounded their treatises on the five phases in it, and Ouyang Xiu's Tang Annals followed suit as well; he recorded only disasters among the various signs and left out auspicious omens—was that not a deliberate judgment of its own?

sentences.zh: 舊史自太祖而嘉禾、瑞麥、甘露、醴泉、芝草之屬，不絕於書，意者諸福畢至，在治世爲宜。

translations.literal: In the old histories from Emperor Taizu onward, fine grain, auspicious wheat, sweet dew, sweet springs, spirit fungus, and the like appear without cease in the records; presumably all blessings had arrived, as befits an age of good government.
translations.idiomatic: In the earlier histories, from Emperor Taizu on, fine grain, auspicious wheat, sweet dew, sweet springs, spirit fungus, and the like fill the pages without end, as though every blessing had come at once—as might be expected in a well-governed age.

sentences.zh: 祥符、宣和之代，人君方務以符瑞文飾一時，而丁謂、蔡京之奸，相與傅會而爲欺，其應果安在哉？

translations.literal: In the Xiangfu and Xuanhe eras, the ruler was busy using portents to adorn the age, while the treachery of Ding Wei and Cai Jing joined in forced interpretation to deceive—where indeed were the responses?
translations.idiomatic: In the Xiangfu and Xuanhe reigns, the court busied itself dressing the age in auspicious portents, while the villainy of Ding Wei and Cai Jing conspired in forced readings to deceive—what responses were there in truth?

sentences.zh: 高宗渡南，心知其非，故《宋史》自建炎而後，郡縣絕無以符瑞聞者，而水旱、劄瘥一切咎征，前史所罕見，皆屢書而無隱。

translations.literal: When Emperor Gaozong crossed south, he knew in his heart that such things were false; therefore in the History of Song from Jianyan onward, the commanderies and counties are never heard to report portents, while flood, drought, plague, and every sign of calamity, rarely seen in earlier histories, are repeatedly recorded without concealment.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Gaozong crossed the Yangtze, knowing such omens for what they were, the History of Song from the Jianyan era onward records no reports of auspicious portents from the counties, yet floods, droughts, pestilence, and every mark of calamity—seldom so fully set down in earlier histories—are entered again and again without concealment.

sentences.zh: 於是六主百五十年，兢兢自保，足以圖存。

translations.literal: Thus for six rulers over a hundred and fifty years, in cautious self-preservation they were able to secure survival.
translations.idiomatic: In this way, through a century and a half under six rulers, the dynasty preserved itself by constant vigilance and was able to endure.

sentences.zh: 《易•震》之《彖》曰：「震來虩虩，恐致福也。」

translations.literal: The Tuan commentary on Zhen in the Book of Changes says: "When thunder comes with dread, fear brings fortune."
translations.idiomatic: The Judgment on the Hexagram Zhen in the Book of Changes says: "Thunder comes with dread; through fear fortune is attained."

sentences.zh: 人君致福之道，有大於恐懼修省者乎？

translations.literal: Is there any path by which a ruler attains fortune greater than fear, reflection, and self-reform?
translations.idiomatic: Is there any surer path to fortune for a ruler than fear, reflection, and self-reform?

sentences.zh: 昔禹致群臣於會稽，黃龍負舟，而執玉帛者萬國。

translations.literal: Of old, Yu assembled the ministers at Kuaiji; a yellow dragon bore the boat, and ten thousand states presented jade and silk.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity Yu gathered his ministers at Kuaiji; a yellow dragon bore his boat upon its back, and rulers from ten thousand states came bearing jade and silk.

sentences.zh: 孔甲好鬼神，二龍降自天，而諸侯相繼畔夏。

translations.literal: Kong Jia delighted in spirits and ghosts; two dragons descended from heaven, yet the feudal lords in succession rebelled against Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Jia doted on spirits and omens; two dragons descended from heaven, yet the feudal lords one after another turned against Xia.

sentences.zh: 桑谷共生於朝，雉升鼎耳而雊，而大戊、武丁復修成湯之政。

translations.literal: Mulberry and grain grew together in the court; a pheasant mounted the cauldron ears and crowed, yet Da Wu and Wu Ding restored the government of Cheng Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Mulberry and grain sprang up together in the court, and a pheasant perched on the cauldron ears and crowed, yet Da Wu and Wu Ding restored the policies of Cheng Tang.

sentences.zh: 穆王得白狼、白鹿，而文、武之業衰焉。

translations.literal: King Mu obtained a white wolf and a white deer, yet the achievements of Wen and Wu declined.
translations.idiomatic: King Mu received a white wolf and a white deer, yet the legacy of King Wen and King Wu fell into decline.

sentences.zh: 徐偃得朱弓矢，宋湣有雀生鸇，二國以霸，亦以之亡。

translations.literal: Xu Yan obtained a vermilion bow and arrows; in Song, a sparrow hatched a goshawk—the two states rose to hegemony and by the same means perished.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Yan received a vermilion bow and arrows; in Song a sparrow hatched a goshawk. Both states rose to dominance—and by those very signs were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 大概征之休咎，猶卦之吉凶，占者有德以勝之則凶可爲吉，無德以當之則吉乃爲凶。

translations.literal: In general, examining fortune and calamity is like the good and ill fortune of the hexagrams: if the diviner has virtue to overcome them, ill fortune may become good; if he lacks virtue to meet them, good fortune becomes ill.
translations.idiomatic: Broadly speaking, auspicious and inauspicious signs resemble the fortune and misfortune of the hexagrams: where the ruler has virtue enough to master them, ill omens may turn to good; where he lacks the virtue to bear them, good omens become ill.

sentences.zh: 故德足勝妖，則妖不足慮；

translations.literal: Therefore when virtue is sufficient to overcome portents, the portents need not be feared;
translations.idiomatic: When virtue is sufficient to overcome evil portents, those portents need not be feared;

sentences.zh: 匪德致瑞，則物之反常者皆足爲妖。

translations.literal: when it is not virtue that brings auspicious signs, then every thing contrary to the norm may serve as a portent of evil.
translations.idiomatic: but when it is not virtue that brings auspicious signs, then every unnatural thing may count as an evil portent.

sentences.zh: 妖不自作，人實興之哉！

translations.literal: Portents do not arise of themselves—humans in truth give rise to them!
translations.idiomatic: Evil portents do not arise of themselves; it is human beings who bring them forth!

sentences.zh: 今因先後史氏所紀休咎之征，匯而輯之，作《五行志》。

translations.literal: Now, taking the signs of fortune and calamity recorded by historians before and after, I have gathered and compiled them to compose the Treatise on the Five Phases.
translations.idiomatic: Here I gather and arrange the signs of fortune and calamity recorded by historians past and present to compose the Treatise on the Five Phases.

sentences.zh: 潤下，水之性也。

translations.literal: To moisten and descend is the nature of water.
translations.idiomatic: To moisten and descend—that is the nature of water.

sentences.zh: 水失其性，則爲災沴。

translations.literal: When water loses its nature, it becomes disaster and calamity.
translations.idiomatic: When water loses its proper nature, disaster follows.

sentences.zh: 舊說以恒寒、鼓妖、魚孽、豕禍、雷電、霜雪、雨雹、黑眚、黑祥皆屬之水，今從之。

translations.literal: Older accounts classed perpetual cold, drum portents, fish anomalies, swine calamities, thunder and lightning, frost and snow, rain and hail, black blights, and black omens all under water; the present work follows them.
translations.idiomatic: Older accounts classified perpetual cold, drum omens, fish anomalies, swine calamities, thunder and lightning, frost and snow, rain and hail, black blights, and black portents under water; this treatise follows that scheme.

sentences.zh: 醴泉、河清雖爲瑞應，苟非其時，未必不爲異，故雜附於編。

translations.literal: Sweet springs and a clear Yellow River, though auspicious responses, if not at the proper season may yet prove strange; therefore they are included here in the compilation.
translations.idiomatic: Sweet springs and a clear Yellow River count as auspicious responses, yet if they come out of season they may prove ominous instead; they are therefore included here as well.

sentences.zh: 他如甘露、嘉禾、芝草一切祥瑞之物，見於後者，因其事而考其時，則休咎自見，故亦各以類相從云。

translations.literal: As for sweet dew, fine grain, spirit fungus, and all other auspicious things appearing later, by examining the event and its time, fortune and calamity reveal themselves; therefore they too are arranged each according to its kind.
translations.idiomatic: Other auspicious things such as sweet dew, fine grain, and spirit fungus that appear later are likewise arranged by kind; when the event is weighed against its time, whether it bodes well or ill becomes clear of itself.

sentences.zh: 乾德二年四月，廣陵、揚子等縣潮水害民田。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year of Qiande, tidal water in Guangling, Yangzi, and other counties harmed the people's fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of Qiande (964), tidal floods damaged farmland in Guangling, Yangzi, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 七月，泰山水，壞民廬舍數百區，牛畜死者甚衆。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Mount Tai flooded; several hundred dwellings of the people were destroyed, and very many cattle and livestock died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, flooding on Mount Tai destroyed several hundred dwellings, and a great many cattle and livestock perished.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，全州大雨水。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year, Quanzhou had great rain and flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year (965), Quanzhou suffered heavy rains and flooding.

sentences.zh: 七月，蘄州大雨水，壞民廬舍。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Qizhou had great rain and flooding, destroying the people's dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, heavy rains and flooding in Qizhou destroyed people's homes.

sentences.zh: 開封府河決，溢陽武。

translations.literal: The river in Kaifeng Prefecture burst its banks and overflowed into Yangwu.
translations.idiomatic: The river in Kaifeng Prefecture broke its banks and flooded Yangwu.

sentences.zh: 河中府、孟州並河水漲，孟州壞中氵單軍營、民舍數百區。

translations.literal: In Hezhong Prefecture and Mengzhou the Yellow River rose together; in Mengzhou several hundred sections of the Zhongtan military camp and civilian dwellings were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River rose in both Hezhong Prefecture and Mengzhou; in Mengzhou several hundred sections of the Zhongtan military camp and civilian dwellings were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 河壞堤岸石，又溢於鄆州，壞民田。

translations.literal: The river destroyed the stone of the dikes and again overflowed into Yanzhou, damaging the people's fields.
translations.idiomatic: The river destroyed the stone revetments of the dikes and overflowed into Yanzhou, ruining farmland.

sentences.zh: 泰州潮水損鹽城縣民田。

translations.literal: Tidal water in Taizhou damaged the people's fields in Yancheng County.
translations.idiomatic: Tidal floods in Taizhou damaged farmland in Yancheng County.

sentences.zh: 淄州、濟州並河溢，害鄒平、高苑縣民田。

translations.literal: In Zizhou and Jizhou the rivers overflowed together, harming the people's fields in Zouping and Gaoyuan counties.
translations.idiomatic: Rivers overflowed in both Zizhou and Jizhou, damaging farmland in Zouping and Gaoyuan counties.

sentences.zh: 四年，東阿縣河溢，損民田。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the river overflowed in Dong'e County and damaged the people's fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year (966), the river overflowed in Dong'e County and damaged farmland.

sentences.zh: 觀城縣河決，壞居民廬舍，注大名。

translations.literal: The river burst its banks in Guancheng County, destroying dwellings of residents and pouring into Daming.
translations.idiomatic: The river broke its banks in Guancheng County, destroying homes and flooding into Daming.

sentences.zh: 又靈河縣堤壞，水東注衛南縣境及南華縣城。

translations.literal: Again the dikes in Linghe County were destroyed; the water flowed east into the territory of Weinan County and the city of Nanhua.
translations.idiomatic: The dikes in Linghe County also failed; the waters flowed east into Weinan County and the city of Nanhua.

sentences.zh: 七月，滎澤縣河南北堤壞。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the dikes north and south of the river in Xingze County were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the dikes on both banks of the river in Xingze County were breached.

sentences.zh: 八月，宿州汴水溢，壞堤。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the Bian River overflowed in Suzhou and destroyed the dikes.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the Bian River overflowed in Suzhou and breached the dikes.

sentences.zh: 淄州清河水溢，壞高苑縣城，溺數百家及鄒平縣田舍。

translations.literal: The Qinghe River overflowed in Zizhou, destroying the city of Gaoyuan County and drowning several hundred households as well as fields and dwellings in Zouping County.
translations.idiomatic: The Qinghe River overflowed in Zizhou, destroying the city of Gaoyuan County and drowning several hundred households along with fields and homes in Zouping County.

sentences.zh: 泗州淮溢。

translations.literal: The Huai River overflowed in Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Huai River overflowed in Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 衡州大雨水月餘。

translations.literal: Hengzhou had great rain and flooding for more than a month.
translations.idiomatic: Hengzhou suffered heavy rains and flooding for more than a month.

sentences.zh: 五年，衛州河溢，毀州城，沒溺者甚衆。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the river overflowed in Weizhou, destroying the prefectural city; very many were drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year (967), the river overflowed in Weizhou, destroying the prefectural city; a great many people drowned.

sentences.zh: 開寶元年六月，州府二十三大雨水，江河泛溢，壞民田、廬舍。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Kaibao, twenty-three prefectures and districts had great rain and flooding; rivers overflowed and destroyed the people's fields and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Kaibao (968), twenty-three prefectures and districts suffered heavy rains and flooding; rivers overflowed and destroyed farmland and homes.

sentences.zh: 七月，泰州潮水害稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, tidal water in Taizhou harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, tidal floods in Taizhou damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 八月，集州霖雨河漲，壞民廬舍及城壁、公署。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, prolonged rain in Jizhou caused the river to rise, destroying the people's dwellings as well as city walls and government offices.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, prolonged rains in Jizhou raised the river and destroyed homes, city walls, and government offices.

sentences.zh: 二年七月，下邑縣河決。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year, the river burst its banks in Xiayi County.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year (969), the river broke its banks in Xiayi County.

sentences.zh: 是歲，青、蔡、宿、淄、宋諸州水，真定、澶、滑、博、洺、齊、潁、蔡、陳、亳、宿、許州水，害秋苗。

translations.literal: That year, Qing, Cai, Su, Zi, and Song prefectures had flooding; Zhending, Chan, Hua, Bo, Ming, Qi, Ying, Cai, Chen, Bo, Su, and Xu prefectures had flooding that harmed the autumn crops.
translations.idiomatic: That year floods struck Qing, Cai, Su, Zi, and Song prefectures, and also Zhending, Chan, Hua, Bo, Ming, Qi, Ying, Cai, Chen, Bo, Su, and Xu, damaging the autumn grain.

sentences.zh: 三年，鄭、澶、鄆、淄、濟、虢、蔡、解、徐、岳州水災，害民田。

translations.literal: In the third year, Zheng, Chan, Yan, Zi, Ji, Guo, Cai, Xie, Xu, and Yue prefectures had flood disasters that harmed the people's fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year (970), floods in Zheng, Chan, Yan, Zi, Ji, Guo, Cai, Xie, Xu, and Yue prefectures damaged farmland.

sentences.zh: 四年六月，汴水決宋州穀熟縣濟陽鎮。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fourth year, the Bian River burst its banks at Jiyang town in Gushu County, Songzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fourth year (971), the Bian River broke its banks at Jiyang town in Gushu County, Songzhou.

sentences.zh: 又鄆州河及汶、清河皆溢，注東阿縣及陳空鎮，壞倉庫、民舍。

translations.literal: Again the river in Yanzhou and the Wen and Qing rivers all overflowed, pouring into Dong'e County and Chenkong town, destroying storehouses and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: The river in Yanzhou and the Wen and Qing rivers also overflowed, flooding Dong'e County and Chenkong town and destroying storehouses and homes.

sentences.zh: 鄭州河決原武縣。

translations.literal: The river burst its banks in Yuanwu County, Zhengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The river broke its banks in Yuanwu County, Zhengzhou.

sentences.zh: 蔡州淮及白露、舒、汝、廬、潁五水並漲，壞廬舍、民田。

translations.literal: In Caizhou the Huai and the Bailu, Shu, Ru, Lu, and Ying rivers all rose together, destroying dwellings and the people's fields.
translations.idiomatic: In Caizhou the Huai and the Bailu, Shu, Ru, Lu, and Ying rivers all rose together, destroying homes and farmland.

sentences.zh: 七月，青、齊州水傷田。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, flooding in Qing and Qi prefectures damaged the fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, floods in Qing and Qi prefectures damaged the fields.

sentences.zh: 五年，河決澶州濮陽，絳、和、廬、壽諸州大水。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the river burst its banks at Puyang in Chanzhou; Jiang, He, Lu, and Shou prefectures had great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year (972), the river broke its banks at Puyang in Chanzhou; Jiang, He, Lu, and Shou prefectures suffered major floods.

sentences.zh: 六月，河又決開封府陽武縣之小劉村。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the river again burst its banks at Xiaoliu village in Yangwu County, Kaifeng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the river broke its banks again at Xiaoliu village in Yangwu County, Kaifeng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宋州、鄭州並汴水決。

translations.literal: In Songzhou and Zhengzhou the Bian River burst its banks together.
translations.idiomatic: The Bian River broke its banks in both Songzhou and Zhengzhou.

sentences.zh: 忠州江水漲二百尺。

translations.literal: The river in Zhongzhou rose two hundred feet.
translations.idiomatic: The Yangtze at Zhongzhou rose two hundred feet.

sentences.zh: 六年，鄆州河決楊劉口。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the river burst its banks at Yangliu mouth in Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year (973), the river broke its banks at Yangliu mouth in Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 懷州河決獲嘉縣。

translations.literal: The river burst its banks in Huojia County, Huaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The river broke its banks in Huojia County, Huaizhou.

sentences.zh: 潁州淮、渒水溢，渰民舍、田疇甚衆。

translations.literal: In Yingzhou the Huai and the Bi River overflowed, inundating very many dwellings and fields.
translations.idiomatic: In Yingzhou the Huai and the Bi River overflowed, inundating a great many homes and fields.

sentences.zh: 七月，曆亭縣御河決。

translations.literal: In the first year of Baoyuan, Jianzhou rained from the first month until the fourth month without cease; brooks rose greatly, entered the prefectural city, destroyed the people's dwellings, and very many drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Baoyuan, rain fell in Jianzhou from the first month through the fourth without stopping; brooks swelled, flooded the prefectural city, destroyed homes, and a great many people drowned.

sentences.zh: 康定元年九月甲寅，滑州大河泛溢，壞民廬舍。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the first year of Kangding, on the day jiayin, the great river in Huazhou overflowed broadly, destroying the people's dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the first year of Kangding, on jiayin, the great river in Huazhou flooded widely and destroyed the people's homes.

sentences.zh: 皇祐元年二月甲戌，河北黃、禦二河決，並注于乾寧軍。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Huangyou, on the day jiaxu, the Yellow and Yu rivers in Hebei breached and together poured into Qianning Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Huangyou, on jiaxu, the Yellow and Yu rivers in Hebei broke their banks and together poured into Qianning Army.

sentences.zh: 河朔頻年水災。

translations.literal: North of the river suffered flood disasters year after year.
translations.idiomatic: The Hebei region suffered floods year after year.

sentences.zh: 二年，鎮定復大水，並邊尤被其害。

translations.literal: In the second year, Zhen and Ding again had great floods; the border regions especially suffered harm.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Zhen and Ding were again inundated, and the border districts suffered especially badly.

sentences.zh: 三年七月辛酉，河決館陶縣郭固口。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year, on the day xinyou, the river breached Guogu Pass in Guantao County.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year, on xinyou, the river broke through at Guogu Pass in Guantao County.

sentences.zh: 八月，汴河絕流。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the Bian Canal ceased to flow.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Bian Canal ran dry.

sentences.zh: 四年八月，鄜州大水，壞軍民廬舍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year, Fuzhou had great floods, destroying military and civilian dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year, severe floods in Fuzhou destroyed military and civilian homes.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐二年六月，開封府界及京東西、河北水潦害民田。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Jiayou, the metropolitan prefecture circuit and Jingdong West and Hebei had waterlogging that harmed the people's fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of Jiayou, waterlogging in the metropolitan district and in Jingdong West and Hebei damaged farmland.

sentences.zh: 自五月大雨不止，水冒安上門，門關折，壞官私廬舍數萬區，城中系栰渡人。

translations.literal: From the fifth month great rain did not cease; water surged over Anshang Gate, the gate barrier broke, and tens of thousands of sections of official and private dwellings were destroyed; in the city people were ferried by moored rafts.
translations.idiomatic: From the fifth month onward rain did not let up; water rose over Anshang Gate and broke the gate barrier, destroying tens of thousands of official and private homes, and within the city people crossed by raft.

sentences.zh: 七月，京東西、荊湖北路水災。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Jingdong West and Jinghu North circuits had flood disasters.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Jingdong West and Jinghu North circuits suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 淮水自夏秋暴漲，環浸泗州城。

translations.literal: From summer through autumn the Huai rose violently; it surrounded and inundated the city of Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: From summer through autumn the Huai swelled violently and surrounded Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 是歲，諸路江河溢決，河北尤甚，民多流亡。

translations.literal: That year, rivers in the circuits overflowed and breached; Hebei was especially severe, and many of the people fled.
translations.idiomatic: That year rivers throughout the circuits overflowed and broke their banks; Hebei was hit hardest, and many people fled.

sentences.zh: 三年七月，京、索、廣濟河溢，浸民田。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year, the Jing, Suo, and Guangji rivers overflowed and inundated the people's fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year, the Jing, Suo, and Guangji rivers overflowed and inundated farmland.

sentences.zh: 五年七月，蘇、湖二州水災。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year, Su and Hu prefectures had flood disasters.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year, Su and Hu prefectures suffered floods.

sentences.zh: 六年七月乙酉，泗州淮水溢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the sixth year, on the day yiyou, the Huai overflowed at Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the sixth year, on yiyou, the Huai overflowed at Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 七年六月，代州大雨，山水暴入城。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the seventh year, great rain in Daizhou caused mountain floods to burst into the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the seventh year, heavy rain in Daizhou sent mountain floods rushing into the city.

sentences.zh: 七月，竇州山水壞城。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, mountain floods in Douzhou destroyed the city wall.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, mountain floods destroyed the walls of Douzhou.

sentences.zh: 河決北京第五埽。

translations.literal: The river breached the Fifth embankment at Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: The river broke through the Fifth embankment at Beijing.

sentences.zh: 熙甯元年秋，霸州山水漲溢，保定軍大水，害稼，壞官私廬舍、城壁，漂溺居民。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the first year of Xining, mountain waters in Bazhou rose and overflowed; Baoding Army had great floods, harming the crops and destroying official and private dwellings and city walls; residents were swept away and drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the first year of Xining, mountain floods surged in Bazhou; Baoding Army was inundated, crops were ruined, official and private homes and city walls were destroyed, and residents were swept away and drowned.

sentences.zh: 河決恩、冀州，漂溺居民。

translations.literal: The river breached in En and Ji prefectures; residents were swept away and drowned.
translations.idiomatic: The river broke its banks in En and Ji prefectures, sweeping away and drowning residents.

sentences.zh: 二年八月，河決滄州饒安，漂溺居民，移縣治于張爲村。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year, the river breached Rao'an in Cangzhou; residents were swept away and drowned, and the county seat was moved to Zhangwei village.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year, the river broke through at Rao'an in Cangzhou, drowning residents, and the county seat was relocated to Zhangwei village.

sentences.zh: 泉州大風雨，水與潮相沖泛溢。

translations.literal: Quanzhou had great wind and rain; water and the tide clashed and overflowed broadly.
translations.idiomatic: Violent wind and rain struck Quanzhou as floodwaters and the tide surged together.

sentences.zh: 損田稼，漂官私廬舍。

translations.literal: Crops were harmed, and official and private dwellings were swept away.
translations.idiomatic: Crops were ruined and official and private homes were swept away.

sentences.zh: 四年八月，金州大水，毀城，壞官私廬舍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year, Jinzhou had great floods, destroying the city wall and official and private dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year, severe floods in Jinzhou destroyed the city walls and official and private homes.

sentences.zh: 七年六月，熙州大雨，洮河泛溢。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the seventh year, great rain in Xizhou caused the Tao River to overflow broadly.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the seventh year, heavy rain in Xizhou sent the Tao River flooding over its banks.

sentences.zh: 八年四月，潭、衡、邵、道諸州江水溢，壞官私廬舍。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the eighth year, the river overflowed in Tan, Heng, Shao, and Dao prefectures, destroying official and private dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the eighth year, rivers overflowed in Tan, Heng, Shao, and Dao prefectures and destroyed official and private homes.

sentences.zh: 九年七月，太原府汾河夏秋霖雨，水大漲。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the ninth year, at Taiyuan Prefecture the Fen River received summer and autumn rains; the water rose greatly.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the ninth year, summer and autumn rains at Taiyuan Prefecture swelled the Fen River.

sentences.zh: 十月，海陽、潮陽二縣海潮溢，壞廬舍，溺居民。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Haiyang and Chaoyang counties had tidal overflow, destroying dwellings and drowning residents.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, tidal floods in Haiyang and Chaoyang counties destroyed homes and drowned residents.

sentences.zh: 十年七月，河決曹村下埽，澶淵絕流，河南徙，又東匯于梁山、張澤濼，凡壞郡縣四十五，官亭、民舍數萬，田三十萬頃。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the tenth year, the river breached Lower Cao Village embankment; Chanyuan ceased to flow, the Henan course shifted, and it again converged eastward at Liangshan and Zhangze marshes; in all forty-five prefectures and counties were harmed, tens of thousands of official pavilions and private houses, and three hundred thousand qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the tenth year, the river broke Lower Cao Village embankment; the Chanyuan channel ran dry, the Henan course shifted, and the waters again gathered eastward toward Liangshan and the Zhangze marshes, ruining forty-five prefectures and counties, tens of thousands of official halls and private dwellings, and three hundred thousand qing of farmland.

sentences.zh: 洺州漳河決，注城。

translations.literal: The Zhang River breached in Mingzhou and poured into the city.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhang River broke its banks in Mingzhou and poured into the city.

sentences.zh: 大雨水，二丈河、陽河水湍漲，壞南倉，溺居民。

translations.literal: Great rain fell; the Erzhang and Yang rivers rose turbulently, destroying the south storehouse and drowning residents.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rains caused the Erzhang and Yang rivers to surge, destroying the south storehouse and drowning residents.

sentences.zh: 滄、衛霖雨不止，河濼暴漲，敗廬舍，損田苗。

translations.literal: Cang and Wei had unceasing rainy-season rain; river marshes rose violently, ruining dwellings and harming the crop seedlings.
translations.idiomatic: Unceasing rains in Cang and Wei sent river marshes surging, destroying homes and damaging crops.

sentences.zh: 元豐元年，章丘河水溢，壞公私廬舍、城壁，漂溺民居。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanfeng, the river in Zhangqiu overflowed, destroying public and private dwellings and city walls; civilian houses were swept away and residents drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanfeng, the river in Zhangqiu overflowed, destroying public and private homes and city walls and sweeping away civilian dwellings.

sentences.zh: 舒州山水暴漲，浸官私廬舍，損田稼，溺居民。

translations.literal: Mountain floods in Shuzhou rose violently, inundating official and private dwellings, harming the crops, and drowning residents.
translations.idiomatic: Mountain floods surged in Shuzhou, inundating official and private homes, ruining crops, and drowning residents.

sentences.zh: 四年四月，澶州臨河縣小吳河溢北流，漂溺居民。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year, the Xiao Wu River in Linhe County, Chanzou overflowed northward; residents were swept away and drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourth year, the Xiao Wu River in Linhe County, Chanzou flooded northward, sweeping away and drowning residents.

sentences.zh: 五月，淮水泛漲。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the Huai broadly flooded.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Huai flooded widely.

sentences.zh: 五年秋。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the fifth year.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the fifth year,

sentences.zh: 陽武、原武二縣河決，壞田廬。

translations.literal: In Yangwu and Yuanwu counties the river breached, destroying fields and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: the river broke its banks in Yangwu and Yuanwu counties, destroying fields and homes.

sentences.zh: 七年六月，青田縣大水，損田稼。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the seventh year, Qingtian County had great floods, harming the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the seventh year, floods in Qingtian County damaged crops.

sentences.zh: 七月，河北東、西路水。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Hebei East and West circuits had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Hebei East and West circuits were inundated.

sentences.zh: 北京館陶水，河溢入府城，壞官私廬舍。

translations.literal: Beijing and Guantao had flooding; the river overflowed into the prefectural city, destroying official and private dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: Flooding struck Beijing and Guantao; the river overflowed into the prefectural city and destroyed official and private homes.

sentences.zh: 八月，趙、邢、洺、磁、相諸州河水泛溢，壞城郭、軍營。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Zhao, Xing, Ming, Ci, and Xiang prefectures had rivers overflowing broadly, destroying city walls and military camps.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, rivers flooded widely in Zhao, Xing, Ming, Ci, and Xiang prefectures, destroying city defenses and military camps.

sentences.zh: 是年，相州漳河決，溺臨漳縣居民。

translations.literal: That year, the Zhang River breached in Xiangzhou; residents of Linzhang County drowned.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Zhang River broke its banks in Xiangzhou, drowning residents of Linzhang County.

sentences.zh: 懷州黃、沁河泛溢，大雨水，損稼，壞廬舍、城壁。

translations.literal: The Yellow and Qin rivers in Huaizhou overflowed broadly; great rain fell, harming the crops and destroying dwellings and city walls.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow and Qin rivers flooded widely in Huaizhou; heavy rains ruined crops and destroyed homes and city walls.

sentences.zh: 磁州諸縣鎮，夏秋漳、滏河水泛溢。

translations.literal: In the counties and towns of Cizhou, in summer and autumn the Zhang and Fu rivers overflowed broadly.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the counties and towns of Cizhou, the Zhang and Fu rivers flooded in summer and autumn.

sentences.zh: 臨漳縣斛律口決，壞官私廬舍，傷田稼，損居民。

translations.literal: Hulu Pass breached in Linzhang County, destroying official and private dwellings, harming the crops, and injuring residents.
translations.idiomatic: Hulu Pass broke open in Linzhang County, destroying official and private homes, damaging crops, and harming residents.

sentences.zh: 元祐四年，夏秋霖雨，河流泛漲。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yuanyou, summer-autumn rains fell incessantly and the rivers broadly flooded.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yuanyou, seasonal rains persisted through summer and autumn and rivers flooded widely.

sentences.zh: 八年，自四月，雨至八月，晝夜不息，畿內、京東西、淮南、河北諸路大水。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, from the fourth month rain until the eighth month did not cease day or night; the metropolitan region, Jingdong West, Huainan, and Hebei circuits had great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, from the fourth month through the eighth month rain fell day and night without ceasing; the metropolitan region and the Jingdong West, Huainan, and Hebei circuits suffered severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 詔開京師宮觀五日，所在州令長吏祈禱，宰臣呂大防等待罪。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the capital's palaces and temples opened for five days; in each prefecture the magistrate and chief officials were to pray; Councillor Lü Dagui and others awaited punishment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered palaces and temples in the capital opened for five days of prayer; local prefectural magistrates were to lead prayers throughout the empire, while Councillor Lü Dagui and others awaited punishment.

sentences.zh: 元符元年，河北、京東等路大水。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanfu, Hebei, Jingdong, and other circuits had great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanfu, Hebei, Jingdong, and other circuits suffered severe floods.

sentences.zh: 二年六月，久雨，陝西、京西、河北大水，河溢，漂人民，壞廬舍。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year, prolonged rain; Shaanxi, Jingxi, and Hebei had great floods; the river overflowed, people were swept away, and dwellings were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year, prolonged rains brought severe floods to Shaanxi, Jingxi, and Hebei; rivers overflowed, people were swept away, and homes were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，兩浙蘇、湖、秀等州尤罹水患。

translations.literal: That year, Su, Hu, Xiu, and other prefectures of the Two Zhe circuits especially suffered water calamity.
translations.idiomatic: That year Su, Hu, Xiu, and other prefectures in the Two Zhe region were especially afflicted by flooding.

sentences.zh: 大觀元年夏，京畿大水。

translations.literal: In the summer of the first year of Daguan, the metropolitan region had great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the first year of Daguan, the metropolitan region suffered severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 詔工部都水監疏導，至於八角鎮。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Ministry of Works Directorate of Water Control to dredge and channel as far as Bajiao town.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Ministry of Works Directorate of Water Control to dredge and channel the waters as far as Bajiao town.

sentences.zh: 河北、京西河溢，漂溺民戶。

translations.literal: Rivers in Hebei and Jingxi overflowed; civilian households were swept away and drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Rivers in Hebei and Jingxi overflowed, sweeping away and drowning common households.

sentences.zh: 十月，蘇、湖水災。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Su and Hu had flood disasters.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Su and Hu suffered floods.

sentences.zh: 二年秋，黃河決，陷沒邢州钜鹿縣。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the second year, the Yellow River breached and swallowed Julu County in Xingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the second year, the Yellow River broke its banks and engulfed Julu County in Xingzhou.

sentences.zh: 三年七月，階州久雨，江溢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year, prolonged rain in Jiezhou; the river overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year, prolonged rain in Jiezhou caused the river to overflow.

sentences.zh: 四年夏，鄧州大水，漂沒順陽縣。

translations.literal: In the summer of the fourth year, Dengzhou had great floods; Shunyang County was swept away and submerged.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the fourth year, severe floods in Dengzhou swept away and submerged Shunyang County.

sentences.zh: 政和五年六月，江甯府、太平、宣州水災。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fifth year of Zhenghe, Jiangning Prefecture, Taiping, and Xuanzhou had flood disasters.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fifth year of Zhenghe, Jiangning Prefecture, Taiping, and Xuanzhou suffered floods.

sentences.zh: 八月，蘇、湖、常、秀諸郡水災。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the prefectures of Su, Hu, Chang, and Xiu had flood disasters.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Su, Hu, Chang, and Xiu prefectures suffered floods.

sentences.zh: 七年，瀛、滄州河決，滄州城不沒者三版，民死者百余萬。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, the river breached in Ying and Cang prefectures; only three courses of Cangzhou's city wall were not submerged; more than a million of the people died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the river broke its banks in Ying and Cang prefectures; only three courses of Cangzhou's wall remained above water, and more than a million people died.

sentences.zh: 重和元年夏，江、淮、荊、浙諸路大水，民流移、溺者衆，分遣使者振濟。

translations.literal: In the summer of the first year of Chonghe, the Jiang, Huai, Jing, and Zhe circuits had great floods; very many of the people drifted away or drowned; emissaries were separately dispatched to give relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the first year of Chonghe, severe floods struck the Jiang, Huai, Jing, and Zhe circuits; many people fled or drowned, and emissaries were dispatched to provide relief.

sentences.zh: 發運使任諒坐不奏泗州壞官私廬舍等勒停。

translations.literal: Transport Commissioner Ren Liang was penalized and suspended for failing to memorialize the destruction of official and private dwellings at Sizhou and related matters.
translations.idiomatic: Transport Commissioner Ren Liang was removed from office for failing to report the destruction of official and private dwellings at Sizhou and related matters.

sentences.zh: 宣和元年五月，大雨，水驟高十餘丈，犯都城，自西北牟駝岡連萬勝門外馬監，居民盡沒。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Xuanhe, great rain fell; the water suddenly rose more than ten zhang, struck the imperial capital, from Motuo Hill in the northwest connecting to the horse stud outside Wansheng Gate, and all residents were submerged.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of Xuanhe, torrential rain raised the waters more than ten zhang overnight, flooding the capital from Motuo Hill in the northwest through the horse stud outside Wansheng Gate and drowning residents throughout.

sentences.zh: 前數日，城中井皆渾，宣和殿后井水溢，蓋水信也。

translations.literal: Several days earlier, all wells in the city were murky; the well behind Xuanhe Hall overflowed—this was surely a sign of flood.
translations.idiomatic: Several days earlier every well in the city had turned muddy, and the well behind Xuanhe Hall overflowed—a sure omen of flood.

sentences.zh: 至是，詔都水使者決西城索河堤殺其勢，城南居民塚墓俱被浸，遂壞藉田親耕之稼。

translations.literal: At this time, an edict ordered the Director of Water Control to breach the Suo River dike west of the city to reduce its force; tombs of residents south of the city were all inundated, and thus the crops of the ploughing field where the emperor personally farmed were ruined.
translations.idiomatic: Then an edict ordered the Director of Water Control to cut the Suo River dike west of the city to slow the flood; tombs of residents south of the city were inundated, and the crops in the sacred ploughing field where the emperor had personally tilled were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 水至溢猛，直冒安上、南薰門，城守凡半月。

translations.literal: The water when it arrived overflowed fiercely, surging straight over Anshang and Nanxun gates; defending the city lasted half a month in all.
translations.idiomatic: The flood surged violently, rising straight over Anshang and Nanxun gates, and the capital was defended for half a month.

sentences.zh: 已而入汴，汴渠將溢，於是募人決下流，由城北入五丈河，下通梁山濼，乃平。

translations.literal: Then it entered the Bian; the Bian canal was about to overflow; thereupon labor was recruited to breach the lower course, from north of the city entering the Wuzhang River, downstream connecting to Liangshan marsh, and then it leveled.
translations.idiomatic: The waters then entered the Bian Canal, which was close to overflowing; laborers were hired to cut the lower channel so the flood could enter the Wuzhang River north of the city and drain down to Liangshan marsh, and the waters subsided.

sentences.zh: 十一月，東南州縣水災。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, southeastern prefectures and counties had flood disasters.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, southeastern prefectures and counties suffered floods.

sentences.zh: 四年十二月戊戌，詔：「訪聞德州有京東、西來流民不少，本州振濟有方，令保奏推恩。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu in the twelfth month of the fourth year, an edict: "Upon inquiry it has been learned that at Dezhou there are not a few displaced persons who have come from Jingdong West; this prefecture has managed relief well—order that this be recommended in memorial for imperial favor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the twelfth month of the fourth year, an edict stated: "Inquiry shows that quite a few refugees from Jingdong West have reached Dezhou; that prefecture has handled relief well. Let this be reported and recommended for imperial reward.

sentences.zh: 余路遇有流移，不即存恤，按劾以聞。」

translations.literal: On other routes, wherever displaced persons are encountered, if relief is not immediately provided, investigate and memorialize to inform the throne."
translations.idiomatic: On other routes, wherever displaced persons are found, those who fail to provide immediate relief are to be investigated and reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 六年秋，京畿恒雨。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the sixth year, the metropolitan region had constant rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the sixth year the metropolitan region saw unceasing rain.

sentences.zh: 河北、京東、兩浙水災，民多流移。

translations.literal: Hebei, Jingdong, and the Two Zhe circuits had flood disasters; many of the people drifted away.
translations.idiomatic: Floods struck Hebei, Jingdong, and the Two Zhe regions, and many people fled.

sentences.zh: 建炎二年春，東南郡國水。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year of Jianyan, the southeastern commanderies had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the second year of Jianyan, the southeastern provinces suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 紹興二年閏月，徽、嚴州水，害稼。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month of the second year of Shaoxing, Hui and Yan prefectures had flooding that harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month of the second year of Shaoxing, floods in Hui and Yan prefectures damaged crops.

sentences.zh: 三年七月丙子，泉州水三日，壞城郭、廬舍。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year, on the day bingzi, Quanzhou had flooding for three days, destroying the city walls and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year, on bingzi, three days of flooding in Quanzhou destroyed city walls and homes.

sentences.zh: 五年秋，西川郡國水。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the fifth year, the commanderies of West Sichuan had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the fifth year, the provinces of western Sichuan suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 六年冬，饒州雨水壞城四百餘丈。

translations.literal: In the winter of the sixth year, rain in Raozhou destroyed more than four hundred zhang of the city wall.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the sixth year, rains in Raozhou destroyed more than four hundred zhang of the city wall.

sentences.zh: 十四年五月丙寅，婺州水。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, in the fifth month, on the day bingyin, Wuzhou had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, in the fifth month, on bingyin, Wuzhou was flooded.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，蘭溪縣水侵縣市，丙寅中夜，水暴至，死者萬余人。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, flooding in Lanxi County invaded the county seat and market; at midnight on bingyin the water surged forth suddenly, and more than ten thousand persons died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, floodwaters in Lanxi County inundated the county seat and market; at midnight on bingyin the waters rose without warning, and more than ten thousand people perished.

sentences.zh: 十六年，潼川府東、南江溢，水入城，浸民廬。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, the eastern and southern rivers of Tongchuan Prefecture overflowed; the water entered the city and soaked civilian dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, the eastern and southern rivers of Tongchuan Prefecture burst their banks, the waters entered the city, and civilian homes were inundated.

sentences.zh: 十八年八月，紹興府、明、婺州水。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the eighteenth year, Shaoxing Prefecture, Ming, and Wuzhou had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the eighteenth year, floods struck Shaoxing Prefecture, Mingzhou, and Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，淮甸水。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, the Huai region had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, the Huai region suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，金堂縣大水。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Jintang County had great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, Jintang County was hit by severe floods.

sentences.zh: 潼川府江溢，浸城內外民廬。

translations.literal: The river of Tongchuan Prefecture overflowed and soaked civilian dwellings inside and outside the city.
translations.idiomatic: The Tongchuan river overflowed, inundating civilian dwellings within and beyond the city walls.

sentences.zh: 宣州大水，其流泛溢至太平州。

translations.literal: Xuanzhou had great flooding; its current spread and overflowed as far as Taiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A major flood at Xuanzhou sent its waters spreading as far as Taiping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 七月，光澤縣大雨，溪流暴湧，平地高十餘丈，人避不及者皆溺，半時即平。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Guangze County had heavy rain; streams surged violently, and on level ground the water stood more than ten zhang high; all who could not flee in time drowned; within half a shichen it subsided.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, torrential rains struck Guangze County; streams rose violently until level ground stood more than ten zhang under water. Those who could not escape drowned; within half an hour the waters fell again.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，鎮江、建康、紹興府、真、太平、池、江、洪、鄂州、漢陽軍大水。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, Zhenjiang, Jiankang, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhen, Taiping, Chi, Jiang, Hong, Ezhou, and Hanyang Circuit had great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, severe floods struck Zhenjiang, Jiankang, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhenzhou, Taiping, Chizhou, Jiangzhou, Hongzhou, Ezhou, and Hanyang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 二十八年六月丙申，興、利二州及大安軍大雨水，流民廬，壞橋棧，死者甚衆。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-eighth year, on the day bingshen, Xing and Li prefectures and Da'an Circuit had heavy rain and flooding; civilian dwellings were swept away, bridges and trestles were destroyed, and very many died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twenty-eighth year, on bingshen, heavy rains and floods in Xing and Li prefectures and Da'an Circuit swept away homes, destroyed bridges and trestle roads, and killed a great many people.

sentences.zh: 九月，江東、淮南數郡水。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, several commanderies east of the Yangtze and in Huainan had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, several prefectures east of the Yangtze and in Huainan suffered floods.

sentences.zh: 浙東、西沿江海郡縣大風、水，平江、紹興府、湖、常、秀、潤爲甚。

translations.literal: The coastal commanderies and counties along the rivers and sea of eastern and western Zhe had great wind and flooding; Pingjiang, Shaoxing Prefecture, Hu, Chang, Xiu, and Run were especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern and western Zhe along the coast saw violent winds and floods; Pingjiang, Shaoxing Prefecture, Huzhou, Changzhou, Xiuzhou, and Runzhou were hardest hit.

sentences.zh: 二十九年七月戊戌，福州水入城，閩、候官、懷安三縣壞田廬，官吏不以聞，憲臣樊光遠坐黜。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twenty-ninth year, on the day wuxu, floodwaters entered Fuzhou; Min, Houguan, and Huai'an counties had fields and dwellings destroyed; officials did not report it, and Investigating Censor Fan Guangyuan was dismissed for the offense.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twenty-ninth year, on wuxu, floodwaters entered Fuzhou; fields and homes in Min, Houguan, and Huai'an counties were ruined. Because officials failed to report the disaster, Investigating Censor Fan Guangyuan was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 三十年五月辛卯夜，於潛、臨安、安吉三縣山水暴出，壞民廬、田桑，溺死者甚衆。

translations.literal: On the night of the day xinmao in the fifth month of the thirtieth year, mountain floods burst forth suddenly in Yuqian, Lin'an, and Anji counties, destroying civilian dwellings and mulberry fields; very many drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of xinmao in the fifth month of the thirtieth year, mountain torrents burst out in Yuqian, Lin'an, and Anji counties, destroying homes and mulberry fields; a great many people drowned.

sentences.zh: 三十一年八月，建始縣大水，流民廬，死者甚衆。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the thirty-first year, Jianshi County had great flooding; civilian dwellings were swept away, and very many died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the thirty-first year, severe flooding in Jianshi County swept away homes and killed a great many people.

sentences.zh: 三十二年四月，淮溢數百里，漂民田廬，死者尤衆。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the thirty-second year, the Huai overflowed for several hundred li, sweeping away civilian fields and dwellings; the dead were especially numerous.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the thirty-second year, the Huai overflowed for hundreds of li, sweeping away farms and homes; casualties were especially heavy.

sentences.zh: 六月，浙西郡縣山湧暴水，漂民舍，壞田覆舟。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, mountain torrents burst forth in the commanderies and counties of western Zhe, sweeping away dwellings, ruining fields, and capsizing boats.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, flash floods from the mountains struck western Zhe, sweeping away houses, destroying crops, and capsizing boats.

sentences.zh: 隆興元年八月，浙東、西州縣大風、水，紹興、平江府、湖州及崇德縣爲甚。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Longxing, the prefectures and counties of eastern and western Zhe had great wind and flooding; Shaoxing, Pingjiang Prefecture, Huzhou, and Chongde County were especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Longxing, eastern and western Zhe were struck by violent winds and floods; Shaoxing, Pingjiang Prefecture, Huzhou, and Chongde County suffered worst.

sentences.zh: 二年七月，平江、鎮江、建康、甯國府、湖、常、秀、池、太平、廬和光州、江陰、廣德、壽春、無爲軍、淮東郡皆大水，浸城郭，壞廬舍、圩田、軍壘。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year, Pingjiang, Zhenjiang, Jiankang, Ningguo Prefecture, Hu, Chang, Xiu, Chi, Taiping, Lu, and Guang prefectures, Jiangyin, Guangde, Shouchun, Wuwei Circuit, and the Huaidong commanderies all had great flooding; city walls were soaked, and dwellings, polder fields, and military stockades were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year, severe floods inundated Pingjiang, Zhenjiang, Jiankang, Ningguo Prefecture, Huzhou, Changzhou, Xiuzhou, Chizhou, Taiping, Luzhou, Guangzhou, Jiangyin, Guangde, Shouchun, Wuwei Circuit, and the Huaidong prefectures, soaking city walls and destroying homes, polder fields, and military encampments.

sentences.zh: 操舟行市者累日，人溺死甚衆。

translations.literal: For many days one rowed boats through the markets; very many people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Boats navigated the markets for days on end, and a great many people drowned.

sentences.zh: 越月，積陰苦雨，水患益甚，淮東有流民。

translations.literal: After a month, prolonged overcast skies and bitter rains made the flood disaster still worse; in Huaidong there were displaced people.
translations.idiomatic: A month later, unending overcast skies and relentless rain worsened the floods, and displaced people appeared in Huaidong.

sentences.zh: 乾道元年六月，常、湖州水壞圩田。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Qiandao, flooding in Chang and Huzhou destroyed polder fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Qiandao, floods in Changzhou and Huzhou destroyed polder fields.

sentences.zh: 二年八月丁亥，溫州大風，海溢，漂民廬、鹽場、龍朔寺，覆舟，溺死二萬余人，江濱胔骼尚七千餘。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year, on the day dinghai, Wenzhou had a great wind; the sea overflowed, sweeping away civilian dwellings, salt works, and Longshuo Temple; boats capsized, and more than twenty thousand drowned; along the riverbank more than seven thousand corpses still remained.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the eighth month of the second year of Qiandao, a great gale struck Wenzhou and the sea surged inland, sweeping away homes, salt pans, and Longshuo Temple. Boats capsized and more than twenty thousand people drowned; along the riverbank more than seven thousand corpses still lay unburied.

sentences.zh: 三年六月，廬、舒、蘄州水，壞苗稼，漂人畜。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year, Lu, Shu, and Qizhou had flooding that destroyed the standing grain and swept away people and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the third year, floods in Luzhou, Shuzhou, and Qizhou destroyed the crops and swept away people and livestock.

sentences.zh: 七月己酉，臨安府天目山湧暴水，決臨安縣五鄉民廬二百八十餘家，人多溺死。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the day jiyou, torrents burst from Tianmu Mountain in Lin'an Prefecture, destroying more than two hundred eighty households in five townships of Lin'an County; very many drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the seventh month, a torrent burst from Tianmu Mountain in Lin'an Prefecture and destroyed more than two hundred eighty households across five townships of Lin'an County; many drowned.

sentences.zh: 八月，湖、秀州、上虞縣水，壞民田廬。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Hu and Xiu prefectures and Shangyu County had flooding that destroyed civilian fields and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, floods in Huzhou, Xiuzhou, and Shangyu County destroyed fields and homes.

sentences.zh: 時積潦至於九月，禾稼皆腐。

translations.literal: At that time standing water lasted until the ninth month, and all the grain crops rotted.
translations.idiomatic: Standing floodwaters persisted until the ninth month, and the grain crops rotted away.

sentences.zh: 江東山水溢，江西諸郡水，隆興府四縣爲甚。

translations.literal: Mountain floods overflowed east of the Yangtze; the commanderies of Jiangxi had flooding; four counties of Longxing Prefecture were especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Mountain floods overflowed in Jiangdong; Jiangxi prefectures flooded; four counties of Longxing Prefecture were hardest hit.

sentences.zh: 四年七月壬戌，衢州大水，敗城三百餘丈，漂民廬，孳牧，壞禾稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year, on the day renxu, Quzhou had great flooding; more than three hundred zhang of the city wall collapsed; civilian dwellings and livestock were swept away, and grain crops were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the seventh month of the fourth year of Qiandao, severe floods at Quzhou collapsed more than three hundred zhang of city wall, swept away homes and livestock, and ruined the crops.

sentences.zh: 諸既縣大水害稼。

translations.literal: Zhuji County had great flooding that harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: Severe flooding in Zhuji County damaged the harvest.

sentences.zh: 江甯、建康府水。

translations.literal: Jiangning and Jiankang prefectures had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangning and Jiankang prefectures suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 是歲，饒、信亦水。

translations.literal: That year, Rao and Xin also had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That year floods also struck Rao and Xin prefectures.

sentences.zh: 五年七月丁巳，建甯府瑞應場大漈、山棗等山暴水湧出，漂民廬，溺死甚衆。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year, on the day dingsi, torrents burst forth from the mountains at Ruiying Field, Daji, and Shanzao in Jianning Prefecture, sweeping away civilian dwellings; very many drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the seventh month of the fifth year, mountain torrents at Ruiying Field, Daji, and Shanzao in Jianning Prefecture swept away homes and drowned a great many people.

sentences.zh: 是歲夏秋，溫、台州凡三大風，水漂民廬，壞田稼，入畜溺死者甚衆，黃岩縣爲甚，郡守王之望、陳岩肖不以聞，皆黜削。

translations.literal: That year in summer and autumn, Wen and Taizhou altogether had three great winds; flooding swept away civilian dwellings and destroyed grain crops; very many people and livestock drowned; Huangyan County was especially severe; the prefects Wang Zhiwang and Chen Yanxiao did not report it and were all dismissed and demoted.
translations.idiomatic: That summer and autumn, Wenzhou and Taizhou suffered three great storms in all; floods swept away homes and ruined crops, drowning a great many people and livestock. Huangyan County was worst hit. Prefects Wang Zhiwang and Chen Yanxiao failed to report the disasters and were dismissed and demoted.

sentences.zh: 六年五月，平江、建康、甯國府、溫、湖、秀、太平州、廣德軍及江西郡大水，江東城市有深丈餘者，漂民廬，湮田稼，潰圩堤，人多流徙。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the sixth year, Pingjiang, Jiankang, Ningguo Prefecture, Wen, Hu, Xiu, Taiping prefectures, Guangde Circuit, and the commanderies of Jiangxi had great flooding; in cities east of the Yangtze some places were more than one zhang deep; civilian dwellings were swept away, fields were submerged, polder dikes burst, and very many people fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the sixth year, severe floods struck Pingjiang, Jiankang, Ningguo Prefecture, Wenzhou, Huzhou, Xiuzhou, Taiping, Guangde Circuit, and Jiangxi. In Jiangdong cities the water stood more than one zhang deep in places; homes were swept away, fields submerged, polder dikes breached, and many fled.

sentences.zh: 八年五月，贛州、南安軍山水暴出，及隆興府、吉、筠州、臨江軍皆大雨水，漂民廬，壞城郭，潰田害稼。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year, mountain floods burst forth in Ganzhou and Nan'an Circuit; Longxing Prefecture, Ji, Jun prefectures, and Linjiang Circuit all had heavy rain and flooding; civilian dwellings were swept away, city walls were destroyed, fields burst and crops were harmed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eighth year, mountain torrents burst out in Ganzhou and Nan'an Circuit; Longxing Prefecture, Ji, Jun, and Linjiang Circuit were deluged; homes were swept away, walls ruined, and fields breached.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，四川郡縣大雨水，嘉、眉、邛、蜀州、永康軍及金堂縣尤甚，漂民廬，決田畝。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renyin, the commanderies and counties of Sichuan had heavy rain and flooding; Jia, Mei, Qiong, Shu prefectures, Yongkang Circuit, and Jintang County were especially severe; civilian dwellings were swept away and fields were breached.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the sixth month, Sichuan prefectures and counties were deluged; Jia, Mei, Qiong, Shu, Yongkang Circuit, and Jintang County were hardest hit, with homes swept away and fields cut through.

sentences.zh: 九年五月戊午，建康、隆興府、嚴、吉、饒、信、池、太平州、廣德軍水，漂民居，壞圩湮田，分水縣沙塞四百餘畝，採石流民多渡江。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the ninth year, on the day wuwu, Jiankang, Longxing Prefecture, Yan, Ji, Rao, Xin, Chi, Taiping prefectures, and Guangde Circuit had flooding; dwellings were swept away, polder fields were submerged, more than four hundred mu of sand blocked Fenshui County, and many displaced people at Caishi crossed the river.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the fifth month of the ninth year, floods struck Jiankang, Longxing Prefecture, Yan, Ji, Rao, Xin, Chi, Taiping, and Guangde Circuit, sweeping away homes and submerging polder fields. Sand blocked more than four hundred mu at Fenshui County, and many refugees at Caishi crossed the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 六月，湖北郡縣水。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the commanderies and counties of Hubei had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Hubei prefectures and counties suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 淳熙元年七月壬寅、癸卯，錢塘大風濤，決臨安府江堤一千六百六十餘丈，漂居民六百三十余家，仁和縣瀕江二鄉壞田圃。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Chunxi, on the days renyin and guimao, great wind and waves at Qiantang breached more than one thousand six hundred sixty zhang of the river dikes of Lin'an Prefecture, swept away more than six hundred thirty households of residents, and in two townships along the river of Renhe County ruined fields and gardens.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin and guimao in the seventh month of the first year of Chunxi, great winds and waves at Qiantang breached more than one thousand six hundred sixty zhang of Lin'an Prefecture's river dikes, swept away more than six hundred thirty households, and ruined fields and gardens in two riverside townships of Renhe County.

sentences.zh: 三年八月辛巳，台州大風雨，至於壬午，海濤、溪流合激爲大水，決江岸，壞民廬，溺死者甚衆。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year, on the day xinsi, Taizhou had great wind and rain; continuing to renwu, sea waves and stream currents combined and surged into great flooding; river banks were breached, civilian dwellings were destroyed, and very many drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the eighth month of the third year of Chunxi, Taizhou was battered by wind and rain through renwu; sea surge and river torrents combined into a great flood that breached the banks, destroyed homes, and drowned a great many.

sentences.zh: 癸未，行都大雨水，壞德勝、江漲、北新三橋及錢塘、余杭、仁和縣田，流入湖、秀州，害稼。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, the capital had heavy rain and flooding; the Desheng, Jiangzhang, and Beixin bridges were destroyed, as were fields in Qiantang, Yuhang, and Renhe counties; the waters flowed into Hu and Xiu prefectures and harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the capital was deluged; the Desheng, Jiangzhang, and Beixin bridges were ruined, along with fields in Qiantang, Yuhang, and Renhe counties. Floodwaters poured into Huzhou and Xiuzhou and damaged the harvest.

sentences.zh: 浙東西、江東郡縣多水，婺州、會稽嵊、廣德軍建平三縣尤甚。

translations.literal: Many commanderies and counties of eastern and western Zhe and Jiangdong had flooding; Wuzhou, Kuaiji Sheng, and the three counties of Guangde Circuit and Jianping were especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Floods struck many prefectures in eastern and western Zhe and Jiangdong; Wuzhou, Sheng of Kuaiji, and the three counties of Guangde Circuit and Jianping were worst affected.

sentences.zh: 四年五月庚子，建寧府、福、南劍州大雨水，至於壬寅，漂民廬數千家。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year, on the day gengzi, Jianning Prefecture, Fu, and Nanjian prefectures had heavy rain and flooding; continuing to renyin, several thousand households of civilian dwellings were swept away.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the fifth month of the fourth year, heavy rains flooded Jianning Prefecture, Fu, and Nanjian prefecture; by renyin several thousand homes had been swept away.

sentences.zh: 己亥夜，錢塘江濤大溢，敗臨安府堤八十餘丈；

translations.literal: On the night of the day jihai, the Qiantang tide overflowed greatly and breached more than eighty zhang of the dikes of Lin'an Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jihai the Qiantang bore surged and breached more than eighty zhang of Lin'an Prefecture's dikes;

sentences.zh: 庚子，又敗堤百餘丈。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, the dikes were again breached for more than one hundred zhang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi another hundred-plus zhang of dikes gave way.

sentences.zh: 明州瀕海大風，海濤敗定海縣堤二千五百餘丈、鄞縣堤五千一百餘丈，漂沒民田。

translations.literal: Mingzhou along the coast had a great wind; sea waves breached more than two thousand five hundred zhang of the dikes of Dinghai County and more than five thousand one hundred zhang of the dikes of Yin County, and civilian fields were swept away and submerged.
translations.idiomatic: A coastal gale at Mingzhou sent sea surge against the dikes, breaching more than two thousand five hundred zhang at Dinghai County and more than five thousand one hundred zhang at Yin County, and submerging farmland.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉、戊戌，大風雨駕海濤，敗錢塘縣堤三百餘丈；

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the days dingyou and wuxu, great wind and rain drove sea waves and breached more than three hundred zhang of the dikes of Qiantang County;
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou and wuxu in the ninth month, wind and rain drove sea surge that breached more than three hundred zhang of Qiantang County's dikes;

sentences.zh: 余姚縣溺死四十餘人，敗堤二千五百六十餘丈；

translations.literal: In Yuyao County more than forty persons drowned, and more than two thousand five hundred sixty zhang of dikes were breached;
translations.idiomatic: More than forty people drowned in Yuyao County, and more than two thousand five hundred sixty zhang of dikes collapsed;

sentences.zh: 敗上虞縣堤及梁湖堰及運河岸；

translations.literal: the dikes of Shangyu County, the Lianghu weir, and the Grand Canal banks were breached;
translations.idiomatic: dikes at Shangyu County, the Lianghu weir, and the Grand Canal embankment failed;

sentences.zh: 定海縣敗堤二千五百餘丈；

translations.literal: in Dinghai County more than two thousand five hundred zhang of dikes were breached;
translations.idiomatic: at Dinghai County more than two thousand five hundred zhang of dikes gave way;

sentences.zh: 鄞縣敗堤五千一百餘丈。

translations.literal: in Yin County more than five thousand one hundred zhang of dikes were breached.
translations.idiomatic: and at Yin County more than five thousand one hundred zhang of dikes collapsed.

sentences.zh: 五年六月戊辰，古田縣大水，漂民廬，圮縣治市橋。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fifth year, on the day wuchen, Gutian County had great flooding; civilian dwellings were swept away, and the county seat, market, and bridge collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen in the sixth month of the fifth year of Chunxi, severe flooding in Gutian County swept away homes and collapsed the county seat, market, and bridge.

sentences.zh: 閏月己亥，階州水，壞城郭。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day jihai, Jiezhou had flooding that destroyed the city walls.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the intercalary month, floods at Jiezhou destroyed the city walls.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，興化軍及福清縣及海口鎮大水，漂民廬、官舍、倉庫，溺死者甚衆。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Xinghua Circuit and Fuqing County and Haikou town had great flooding; civilian dwellings, official quarters, and storehouses were swept away; very many drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, great floods struck Xinghua Circuit, Fuqing County, and Haikou town, sweeping away homes, government buildings, and storehouses; a great many drowned.

sentences.zh: 六年夏，衢州水。

translations.literal: In the summer of the sixth year, Quzhou had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the sixth year, Quzhou suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 秋，甯國府、溫、台、湖、秀、太平州水，壞圩田，樂清縣溺死者百餘人。

translations.literal: In the autumn, Ningguo Prefecture, Wen, Tai, Hu, Xiu, and Taiping prefectures had flooding that destroyed polder fields; in Yueqing County more than one hundred persons drowned.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, floods in Ningguo Prefecture, Wenzhou, Taizhou, Huzhou, Xiuzhou, and Taiping destroyed polder fields; more than one hundred drowned in Yueqing County.

sentences.zh: 七年五月戊戌，分宜縣大水，決田害稼。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the seventh year, on the day wuxu, Fenyi County had great flooding; fields were breached and crops harmed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the fifth month of the seventh year, severe flooding at Fenyi County breached fields and ruined the harvest.

sentences.zh: 八年五月壬辰，嚴州大水，漂浸民居萬九千五百四十餘家、壘舍六百八十余區。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year, on the day renchen, Yanzhou had great flooding; more than nineteen thousand five hundred forty households and more than six hundred eighty sections of stockade buildings were swept away and soaked.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the fifth month of the eighth year, Yanzhou was inundated; floods swept or soaked more than nineteen thousand five hundred forty households and more than six hundred eighty military compounds.

sentences.zh: 紹興府大水，五縣漂浸民居八萬三千余家，田稼盡腐；

translations.literal: Shaoxing Prefecture had great flooding; in five counties more than eighty-three thousand households were swept away and soaked, and the grain crops all rotted;
translations.idiomatic: Severe floods at Shaoxing Prefecture inundated more than eighty-three thousand households across five counties and ruined the entire harvest;

sentences.zh: 漁浦敗堤五百餘丈，新林敗堤通運河。

translations.literal: at Yubu more than five hundred zhang of dikes collapsed, and at Xinlin the dikes collapsed through to the Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: at Yubu more than five hundred zhang of dikes failed, and at Xinlin dikes collapsed into the Grand Canal.

sentences.zh: 是歲，徽、江二州亦水。

translations.literal: That year, Hui and Jiang prefectures also had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That year floods also struck Hui and Jiang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 十年五月辛巳，信州大水入城，沈廬舍、市井。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the tenth year, on the day xinsi, great flooding entered Xinzhou; dwellings and market streets were submerged.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the fifth month of the tenth year, floodwaters entered Xinzhou; homes and market streets were submerged.

sentences.zh: 襄陽府大水，漂民廬，蓋藏爲空。

translations.literal: Xiangyang Prefecture had great flooding; civilian dwellings were swept away, and storehouses were emptied.
translations.idiomatic: Severe floods at Xiangyang Prefecture swept away homes and emptied storehouses.

sentences.zh: 江東、浙東數郡亦水。

translations.literal: Several commanderies east of the Yangtze and in eastern Zhe also had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Several prefectures in Jiangdong and eastern Zhe also flooded.

sentences.zh: 八月辛酉，雷州大風激海濤，沒瀕海民舍，死者甚衆。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day xinyou, Leizhou had a great wind that drove sea waves; coastal dwellings were submerged; very many died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the eighth month, a great gale at Leizhou drove sea surge inland and submerged coastal homes; casualties were heavy.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑，福、漳州大風雨，水暴至，長溪、寧德縣瀕海聚落、廬舍、人舟皆漂入海，漳城半沒，浸八百九十餘家。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day yichou, Fu and Zhang prefectures had great wind and rain; the water surged forth suddenly; coastal settlements, dwellings, and boats of people in Changxi and Ningde counties were all swept into the sea; half of Zhang city was submerged, soaking more than eight hundred ninety households.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the ninth month, wind and rain lashed Fu and Zhang prefectures and waters rose without warning. Coastal settlements, homes, and boats in Changxi and Ningde counties were swept into the sea; half of Zhang city was submerged, inundating more than eight hundred ninety households.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，吉州龍泉縣大水，漂民廬，壞田畝，溺死者衆。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Longquan County in Jizhou had great flooding; civilian dwellings were swept away, fields were destroyed, and very many drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, severe flooding in Longquan County, Jizhou, swept away homes, ruined fields, and drowned many.

sentences.zh: 十一年四月，和州水，湮民廬，壞圩田。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the eleventh year, Hezhou had flooding that submerged civilian dwellings and destroyed polder fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the eleventh year, floods at Hezhou submerged homes and destroyed polder fields.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申，階州白江水溢，決堤圮城，浸民廬、壘舍、祠廟、寺觀甚多。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day bingshen, the Bai River in Jiezhou overflowed, dikes were breached and the city wall collapsed, and very many civilian dwellings, stockade buildings, shrines, temples, and monasteries were soaked.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the fifth month, the Bai River at Jiezhou overflowed, breaching dikes and collapsing the wall; homes, barracks, shrines, temples, and monasteries were widely inundated.

sentences.zh: 建康府、太平州水。

translations.literal: Jiankang Prefecture and Taiping Prefecture had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Jiankang Prefecture and Taiping Prefecture suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 六月甲申，處州龍泉縣大雨，水浸民舍，壞杠梁，匯田害稼。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jiashen, Chuzhou's Longquan County had heavy rain; water soaked civilian dwellings, bridges and beams were destroyed, fields converged into floods and crops were harmed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the sixth month, heavy rains at Longquan County in Chuzhou inundated homes, destroyed bridges and beams, and turned fields into torrents that ruined the crops.

sentences.zh: 七月壬辰，明州大風雨，山水暴出，浸民市，圮民廬，覆舟殺人。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the day renchen, Mingzhou had great wind and rain; mountain floods burst forth, soaking the civilian markets, collapsing dwellings, and capsizing boats and killing people.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the seventh month, wind and rain at Mingzhou sent mountain torrents through the markets, collapsing homes and capsizing boats with loss of life.

sentences.zh: 十二年六月，婺州及富陽縣皆水，浸民廬，害田稼。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twelfth year, Wuzhou and Fuyang County both had flooding that soaked civilian dwellings and harmed grain crops.
