translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twelfth year, floods at Wuzhou and Fuyang County inundated homes and damaged crops.

sentences.zh: 八月戊寅，安吉縣暴水發棗園村，漂廬舍、寺觀，壞田稼殆盡，溺死千餘人，郡守劉藻不以聞，坐黜。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day wuyin, a flash flood burst from Zaoyuan village in Anji County, sweeping away dwellings and temples and monasteries, nearly destroying all the grain crops, and drowning more than one thousand persons; the prefect Liu Zao did not report it and was dismissed for the offense.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the eighth month, a flash flood from Zaoyuan village in Anji County swept away homes, temples, and monasteries, nearly ruining the entire harvest, and drowned more than one thousand people. Prefect Liu Zao failed to report it and was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 是歲，鄂州自夏徂冬，水浸民廬。

translations.literal: That year, from summer through winter, Ezhou had flooding that soaked civilian dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ezhou remained inundated from summer through winter.

sentences.zh: 九月，台州水。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Taizhou had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Taizhou suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 十四年三月辛未，汀州水，漂百餘家、軍壘六十余區。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourteenth year, on the day xinwei, Tingzhou had flooding; more than one hundred households and more than sixty sections of military stockades were swept away.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the third month of the fourteenth year, floods at Tingzhou swept away more than one hundred households and more than sixty military compounds.

sentences.zh: 十五年五月，淮甸大雨水，淮水溢，廬、濠、楚州、無爲、安豐、高郵、盱眙軍皆漂廬舍、田稼，廬州城圮。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifteenth year, the Huai region had heavy rain and flooding; the Huai overflowed; Lu, Hao, Chu prefectures, Wuwei, Anfeng, Gaoyou, and Xuyi Circuit all had dwellings and grain crops swept away, and the city wall of Luzhou collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fifteenth year, torrential rains flooded the Huai region; the river overflowed; Lu, Hao, Chu, Wuwei, Anfeng, Gaoyou, and Xuyi Circuit saw homes and crops swept away, and Luzhou's wall collapsed.

sentences.zh: 荊江溢，鄂州大水，漂軍民 壘舍三千餘。

translations.literal: The Jing River overflowed; Ezhou had great flooding; more than three thousand military and civilian stockade buildings were swept away.
translations.idiomatic: The Jing overflowed; severe floods at Ezhou swept away more than three thousand military and civilian compounds.

sentences.zh: 江陵、常德、德安府、復、嶽、澧州、漢陽軍水。

translations.literal: Jiangling, Changde, De'an Prefecture, Fu, Yue, Li prefectures, and Hanyang Circuit had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Floods struck Jiangling, Changde, De'an Prefecture, Fu, Yue, Li, and Hanyang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 戊午，祁門縣群山暴匯爲大水，漂田禾、廬舍、塚墓、桑麻、人畜什六七，浮胔甚衆，及害及浮梁縣。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, the mountains around Qimen County suddenly converged into great flooding; grain fields, dwellings, tombs, mulberry, hemp, people, and livestock—six or seven tenths were swept away; floating corpses were very numerous; the harm also reached Fuliang County.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, mountain torrents around Qimen County converged into a catastrophic flood, sweeping away six or seven tenths of crops, homes, tombs, mulberry, hemp, people, and livestock. Corpses floated in great numbers, and Fuliang County was also harmed.

sentences.zh: 六月，建寧、隆興府、袁、撫州、臨江軍水圮民廬。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Jianning, Longxing Prefecture, Yuan, Fu prefectures, and Linjiang Circuit had flooding that collapsed civilian dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, floods collapsed homes in Jianning, Longxing Prefecture, Yuan, Fu, and Linjiang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 七月，黃岩縣水敗田瀦。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, flooding in Huangyan County destroyed flooded fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, floods at Huangyan County ruined inundated fields.

sentences.zh: 番昜湖溢番昜縣，漂民舍、田稼，有流徙者。

translations.literal: Poyang Lake overflowed into Poyang County; dwellings and grain crops were swept away, and some people fled.
translations.idiomatic: Poyang Lake overflowed into Poyang County, sweeping away homes and crops; some fled.

sentences.zh: 十六年四月甲戌，紹興府新昌縣山水暴作，害稼湮田，漂民廬。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the sixteenth year, on the day jiaxu, mountain floods burst forth suddenly in Xinchang County, Shaoxing Prefecture, harming crops and submerging fields and sweeping away civilian dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the fourth month of the sixteenth year, flash floods in Xinchang County, Shaoxing Prefecture, ruined crops, submerged fields, and swept away homes.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰，沅、靖州山水暴溢至辰州，常德府城沒一丈五尺，漂民廬舍。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day bingchen, mountain floods in Yuan and Jing prefectures suddenly overflowed as far as Chenzhou; the city of Changde Prefecture was submerged one zhang five chi; civilian dwellings were swept away.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the fifth month, mountain torrents in Yuan and Jing prefectures surged as far as Chenzhou; Changde's city stood one zhang five chi under water and homes were swept away.

sentences.zh: 汀州大水，浸民廬千五百餘家，溺死三千人。

translations.literal: Tingzhou had great flooding; more than one thousand five hundred households of civilian dwellings were soaked, and three thousand persons drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Severe floods at Tingzhou inundated more than one thousand five hundred homes and drowned three thousand people.

sentences.zh: 分宜縣水。

translations.literal: Fenyi County had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Fenyi County suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，階州白江水溢，浸城市民廬。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, the Bai River in Jiezhou overflowed and soaked the dwellings of the city populace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the Bai River at Jiezhou overflowed and inundated the city's homes.

sentences.zh: 六月庚寅，鎮江府大雨水五日，浸軍民壘舍三千餘。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day gengyin, Zhenjiang Prefecture had heavy rain and flooding for five days; more than three thousand military and civilian stockade buildings were soaked.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the sixth month, five days of torrential rain flooded Zhenjiang Prefecture, inundating more than three thousand military and civilian compounds.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，潼川府東南二江溢，決堤，毀橋，浸民廬，涪城、中江、射洪、通泉、郪縣沒田廬。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, the southeastern two rivers of Tongchuan Prefecture overflowed; dikes were breached, bridges were destroyed, civilian dwellings were soaked, and in Fucheng, Zhongjiang, Shehong, Tongquan, and Qi counties fields and dwellings were submerged.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the southeastern rivers of Tongchuan Prefecture overflowed, breaching dikes, destroying bridges, and inundating homes; Fucheng, Zhongjiang, Shehong, Tongquan, and Qi counties saw fields and dwellings submerged.

sentences.zh: 紹熙二年三月，甯化縣連水漂廬舍、田畝，溺死二十餘人。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year of Shaoxi, Ninghua County had successive flooding that swept away dwellings and fields; more than twenty persons drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year of Shaoxi, repeated floods in Ninghua County swept away homes and fields and drowned more than twenty people.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，建甯州水。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day wushen, Jianning prefecture had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the fifth month, Jianning prefecture flooded.

sentences.zh: 己酉，福州水，浸附郭民廬，懷安、候官縣漂千三百餘家，古田、閩清縣亦壞田廬。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Fuzhou had flooding that soaked the dwellings of the outer suburbs; in Huai'an and Houguan counties more than one thousand three hundred households were swept away; Gutian and Minqing counties also had fields and dwellings destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, floods at Fuzhou inundated suburban homes; more than one thousand three hundred households were swept away in Huai'an and Houguan counties, and Gutian and Minqing counties also lost fields and homes.

sentences.zh: 庚午，利州東江溢。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, the eastern river of Lizhou overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the eastern river of Lizhou overflowed.

sentences.zh: 壞堤、田、廬舍。

translations.literal: Dikes, fields, and dwellings were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Dikes, fields, and dwellings were ruined.

sentences.zh: 辛未，潼川府東、南江溢；

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, the eastern and southern rivers of Tongchuan Prefecture overflowed;
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the eastern and southern rivers of Tongchuan Prefecture overflowed;

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅，又溢，再壞堤橋，水入城，沒廬舍七百四十餘家，郪、涪、射洪、通泉縣匯田爲江者千餘畝。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day wuyin, they overflowed again; dikes and bridges were again destroyed; water entered the city; more than seven hundred forty dwellings were submerged; in Qi, Fu, Shehong, and Tongquan counties more than one thousand mu of fields converged into rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the sixth month the rivers overflowed again, destroying dikes and bridges once more; waters entered the city and submerged more than seven hundred forty homes; in Qi, Fu, Shehong, and Tongquan counties more than one thousand mu of farmland became river.

sentences.zh: 七月癸亥，嘉陵江暴溢，興州圮城門、郡獄、官舍凡十七所，漂民居三千四百九十餘，潼川崇慶府、綿、果、合、金、龍、漢州、懷安、石泉、大安軍魚關皆水。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the day guihai, the Jialing River suddenly overflowed; Xingzhou had seventeen structures including city gates, the prefectural prison, and official quarters collapse; more than three thousand four hundred ninety civilian dwellings were swept away; Tongchuan, Chongqing Prefecture, Mian, Guo, He, Jin, Long, and Han prefectures, Huai'an, Shiquan, and Yuguan in Da'an Circuit all had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the seventh month the Jialing River burst its banks. At Xingzhou seventeen sites—the city gates, prefectural prison, and government buildings—collapsed, and more than three thousand four hundred ninety homes were swept away. Floods also struck Tongchuan, Chongqing Prefecture, Mian, Guo, He, Jin, Long, and Han prefectures, Huai'an, Shiquan, and Yuguan in Da'an Circuit.

sentences.zh: 時上流西蕃界古松州江水暴溢，龍州敗橋閣五百余區，江油縣溺死者衆。

translations.literal: At that time upstream on the western Tibetan frontier at Gusong prefecture the river water suddenly overflowed; in Longzhou more than five hundred sections of bridges and pavilions were destroyed; in Jiangyou County very many drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile upstream on the western Tibetan border the Gusong prefecture river surged without warning. Longzhou lost more than five hundred bridges and trestleworks, and drowning casualties were heavy in Jiangyou County.

sentences.zh: 三年五月壬辰，常德府大雨水，浸民田廬。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the third year, on the day renchen, Changde Prefecture had heavy rain and flooding that soaked civilian fields and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the fifth month of the third year, torrential rains flooded Changde Prefecture, inundating farms and homes.

sentences.zh: 乙未，潼川府東、南江溢，後六日又溢，浸城外民廬，人徙於山。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the eastern and southern rivers of Tongchuan Prefecture overflowed; six days later they overflowed again, soaking the civilian dwellings outside the city; people moved to the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the eastern and southern rivers of Tongchuan Prefecture overflowed. Six days later they rose again, flooding homes beyond the walls, and people fled to the hills.

sentences.zh: 己亥，池州大雨水連夕，青陽縣山水暴湧，漂田廬殺人，蓋藏無遺；

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Chizhou had heavy rain and flooding through the night; in Qingyang County mountain waters surged forth suddenly, sweeping away fields and dwellings and killing people; storehouses were left with nothing;
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Chizhou was lashed by rain through the night. Mountain torrents burst upon Qingyang County, sweeping away fields and homes, killing people, and leaving storehouses utterly bare;

sentences.zh: 貴池縣亦水。

translations.literal: Guichi County also had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Guichi County flooded as well.

sentences.zh: 庚子，涇縣大雨水，敗堤，圮縣治、廬舍。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Jing County had heavy rain and flooding; dikes were breached; the county seat and dwellings collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, heavy rains at Jing County breached the dikes and collapsed the county seat and private homes.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑，建平縣水，敗堤入城，漂浸民廬。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day xinchou, Jianping County had flooding; dikes were breached and water entered the city; civilian dwellings were swept away and soaked.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the sixth month, floods at Jianping County broke the dikes, poured into the town, and swept or soaked countless homes.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，祁門縣水。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Qimen County had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Qimen County suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 七月壬申，天臺、仙居縣大水連夕，漂浸民居五百六十余，壞田傷稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the day renshen, Tiantai and Xianju counties had great flooding through the night; more than five hundred sixty dwellings were swept away and soaked; fields were destroyed and crops harmed.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the seventh month, Tiantai and Xianju counties were inundated night after night; more than five hundred sixty homes were swept away or submerged, and fields and crops were ruined.

sentences.zh: 襄陽、江陵府大雨水，漢江溢，敗堤防，圮民廬、沒田稼者逾旬，復州、荊門軍水亦如之。

translations.literal: Xiangyang and Jiangling prefectures had heavy rain and flooding; the Han River overflowed; dikes were breached; civilian dwellings collapsed and grain crops were submerged for more than ten days; Fuzhou and Jingmen Circuit also had flooding like this.
translations.idiomatic: Torrential rains struck Xiangyang and Jiangling prefectures as the Han overflowed, breaching dikes and collapsing homes; submerged crops lasted more than ten days. Fuzhou and Jingmen Circuit suffered likewise.

sentences.zh: 鎮江府三縣水，損下地之稼。

translations.literal: Three counties of Zhenjiang Prefecture had flooding, harming the crops of low-lying land.
translations.idiomatic: Floods in three counties of Zhenjiang Prefecture ruined the harvest on low ground.

sentences.zh: 四年四月，上高縣水，浸二百餘家。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year, Shanggao County had flooding that soaked more than two hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourth year, flooding at Shanggao County inundated more than two hundred households.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申、癸酉，奉新縣大雷雨、水，漂浸八百二十餘家。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the days renshen and guiyou, Fengxin County had great thunder, rain, and flooding; more than eight hundred twenty households were swept away and soaked.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen and guiyou in the fifth month, thunderstorms and floods struck Fengxin County, sweeping or soaking more than eight hundred twenty households.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未、丙子，鎮江府大雨水，浸營壘六千余區。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the days xinwei and bingzi, Zhenjiang Prefecture had heavy rain and flooding that soaked more than six thousand sections of stockade buildings.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei and bingzi in the fifth month, torrential rain flooded Zhenjiang Prefecture, inundating more than six thousand military compounds.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，安豐軍大水，平地三丈余，漂田廬，絲麥皆空。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Anfeng Circuit had great flooding; on level ground it was more than three zhang deep; fields and dwellings were swept away; silk and wheat were all emptied.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Anfeng Circuit was deluged to more than three zhang on flat ground. Fields and homes were swept away, and the silk and wheat crops were wiped out.

sentences.zh: 是月，諸暨、蕭山、宣城、甯國縣大水，壞田稼。

translations.literal: That month, Zhuji, Xiaoshan, Xuancheng, and Ningguo counties had great flooding that destroyed grain crops.
translations.idiomatic: That month severe floods in Zhuji, Xiaoshan, Xuancheng, and Ningguo counties ruined the harvest.

sentences.zh: 廣德軍屬縣水害稼。

translations.literal: Subordinate counties of Guangde Circuit had flooding that harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: Floods in the counties under Guangde Circuit damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 筠州水浸民廬。

translations.literal: Yunzhou had flooding that soaked civilian dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: Floods at Yunzhou inundated people's homes.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，進賢縣水，圮百二十餘家。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Jinxian County had flooding; more than one hundred twenty households collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, flooding at Jinxian County collapsed more than one hundred twenty households.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，興國軍水，池口鎮及大冶縣漂民廬，有溺死者。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day bingshen, Xingguo Circuit had flooding; at Chikou town and Daye County civilian dwellings were swept away; there were persons who drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the sixth month, floods struck Xingguo Circuit, sweeping away homes at Chikou town and in Daye County; some drowned.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，靖安縣水，漂三百二十餘家。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Jing'an County had flooding; more than three hundred twenty households were swept away.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, flooding at Jing'an County swept away more than three hundred twenty households.

sentences.zh: 是夏，江、贛州、江陵府亦水。

translations.literal: That summer, Jiang, Gan, and Jiangling prefectures also had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That summer Jiang, Gan, and Jiangling prefectures flooded as well.

sentences.zh: 七月乙酉，豐城縣水，壬午，臨江軍水，皆圮民廬。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the day yiyou, Fengcheng County had flooding; on the day renwu, Linjiang Circuit had flooding; in both cases civilian dwellings collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the seventh month Fengcheng County flooded; on renwu Linjiang Circuit did likewise—civilian homes collapsed in both places.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，新淦縣漂浸二千三百餘家。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Xingan County had more than two thousand three hundred households swept away and soaked.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, floods at Xingan County swept or soaked more than two thousand three hundred households.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，隆興府水，圮千二百七十餘家。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day xinchou, Longxing Prefecture had flooding; more than one thousand two hundred seventy households collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the eighth month, flooding at Longxing Prefecture collapsed more than one thousand two hundred seventy households.

sentences.zh: 吉州水，漂浸民廬及泰和縣官舍。

translations.literal: Jizhou had flooding; civilian dwellings and the official quarters of Taihe County were swept away and soaked.
translations.idiomatic: Floods at Jizhou swept or soaked homes and the government buildings of Taihe County.

sentences.zh: 自夏及秋，江西九州三十七縣皆水。

translations.literal: From summer through autumn, the nine prefectures and thirty-seven counties of Jiangxi all had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: From summer through autumn, floods covered all nine prefectures and thirty-seven counties of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 是歲，興化軍大風激海濤，漂沒田廬尤多。

translations.literal: That year, Xinghua Circuit had a great wind that drove sea waves; fields and dwellings swept away and submerged were especially numerous.
translations.idiomatic: That year a great gale at Xinghua Circuit drove the sea inland, sweeping away an especially large number of fields and homes.

sentences.zh: 五年五月辛未，石埭、貴池、涇縣皆水，圮民廬，溺死者衆。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year, on the day xinwei, Shidi, Guichi, and Jing counties all had flooding; civilian dwellings collapsed; very many drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the fifth month of the fifth year, Shidi, Guichi, and Jing counties flooded, homes collapsed, and drowning casualties were heavy.

sentences.zh: 是月，泰州大水。

translations.literal: That month, Taizhou had great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That month Taizhou was severely flooded.

sentences.zh: 七月壬申，慈溪縣水，漂民廬，決田害稼，人多溺死。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the day renshen, Cixi County had flooding; civilian dwellings were swept away; fields were breached and crops harmed; very many drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the seventh month, floods at Cixi County swept away homes, breached fields, ruined the crops, and drowned many.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，會稽、山陰、蕭山、余姚、上虞縣大風駕海濤，壞堤，傷田稼。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Kuaiji, Shanyin, Xiaoshan, Yuyao, and Shangyu counties had a great wind driving sea waves; dikes were destroyed; grain crops were harmed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, a gale drove sea surge through Kuaiji, Shanyin, Xiaoshan, Yuyao, and Shangyu counties, destroying dikes and damaging the harvest.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，錢塘、臨安、新城、富陽、於潛縣大雨水，余杭縣尤甚，漂沒田廬，死者無算。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day xinchou, Qiantang, Lin'an, Xincheng, Fuyang, and Yuqian counties had heavy rain and flooding; Yuhang County was especially severe; fields and dwellings were swept away and submerged; the dead were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the eighth month, torrential rains struck Qiantang, Lin'an, Xincheng, Fuyang, and Yuqian counties, worst of all at Yuhang, sweeping away fields and homes with casualties beyond count.

sentences.zh: 安吉縣水，平地丈餘。

translations.literal: Anji County had flooding; on level ground it was more than one zhang deep.
translations.idiomatic: Anji County flooded to more than one zhang on flat ground.

sentences.zh: 平江、鎮江、甯國府、明、台、溫、嚴、常州、江陰軍皆水。

translations.literal: Pingjiang, Zhenjiang, Ningguo Prefecture, Ming, Tai, Wen, Yan, Chang, and Jiangyin Circuit all had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Floods struck Pingjiang, Zhenjiang, Ningguo Prefecture, Mingzhou, Taizhou, Wenzhou, Yanzhou, Changzhou, and Jiangyin Circuit.

sentences.zh: 是秋。

translations.literal: That autumn.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn,

sentences.zh: 武陵縣江溢，圮田廬甚衆。

translations.literal: Wuling County's river overflowed; very many fields and dwellings collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: the river overflowed at Wuling County, collapsing a great many fields and homes.

sentences.zh: 慶元元年六月壬申，台州及屬縣大風雨，山洪、海濤並作，漂沒田廬無算，死者蔽川，漂沉旬日。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Qingyuan, on the day renshen, Taizhou and its subordinate counties had great wind and rain; mountain floods and sea waves arose together; fields and dwellings swept away and submerged were beyond counting; the dead covered the rivers; bodies drifted and sank for ten days.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the sixth month of the first year of Qingyuan, wind and rain lashed Taizhou and its counties as mountain torrents and sea surge struck together. Countless fields and homes were swept away; corpses choked the streams, drifting and sinking for ten days.

sentences.zh: 至於七月甲寅，黃岩縣水尤甚。

translations.literal: By the seventh month, on the day jiayin, Huangyan County had flooding that was especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: By jiayin in the seventh month flooding at Huangyan County was especially severe.

sentences.zh: 常平使者莫漳以緩於振恤，坐免。

translations.literal: The Ever-Normal Granary commissioner Mo Zhang, for being slow in relief and aid, was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Ever-Normal Granary commissioner Mo Zhang was dismissed for delaying disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 七月，臨安府水。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Lin'an Prefecture had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Lin'an Prefecture flooded.

sentences.zh: 二年秋，浙東郡國大水。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the second year, the commanderies and kingdoms of eastern Zhe had great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn of the second year, eastern Zhe was widely inundated.

sentences.zh: 三年九月，紹興府屬縣二婺州屬縣二，水害稼，五年秋，台、溫衢、婺水，漂民廬，人多溺死，衢守張經以匿災吝振坐黜。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the third year, two subordinate counties of Shaoxing Prefecture and two subordinate counties of Wuzhou had flooding that harmed crops; in the autumn of the fifth year, Tai, Wen, Qu, and Wu had flooding; civilian dwellings were swept away; very many drowned; Qu prefect Zhang Jing, for concealing the disaster and being stingy in relief, was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the third year floods harmed crops in two Shaoxing counties and two Wuzhou counties. In the autumn of the fifth year Taizhou, Wenzhou, Quzhou, and Wuzhou flooded, sweeping away homes and drowning many. Quzhou prefect Zhang Jing was dismissed for concealing the disaster and withholding relief.

sentences.zh: 六年五月，建甯府、嚴、衢、婺、饒、信、徽、南劍州及江西郡縣皆大水，自庚午至於甲戌，漂民廬，害稼。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the sixth year, Jianning Prefecture, Yan, Qu, Wu, Rao, Xin, Hui, Nanjian prefecture, and the commanderies and counties of Jiangxi all had great flooding; from gengwu through jiaxu civilian dwellings were swept away and crops were harmed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the sixth year great floods struck Jianning Prefecture, Yan, Qu, Wu, Rao, Xin, Hui, Nanjian, and Jiangxi generally. From gengwu to jiaxu homes were swept away and crops ruined.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰二年七月丙午，上杭縣水，圮田廬，壞稼，民多溺死。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Jiatai, on the day bingwu, Shanghang County had flooding; fields and dwellings collapsed; crops were destroyed; very many civilians drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the seventh month of the second year of Jiatai, floods at Shanghang County collapsed fields and homes, ruined the harvest, and drowned many.

sentences.zh: 建安縣漂軍民廬舍百二十餘，山摧，覆民廬七十七家，溺壓死者六十余。

translations.literal: Jian'an County had more than one hundred twenty military and civilian dwellings swept away; mountains collapsed, burying seventy-seven civilian dwellings; more than sixty died by drowning or crushing.
translations.idiomatic: At Jian'an County floods swept away more than one hundred twenty military and civilian buildings. Landslides buried seventy-seven homes, and more than sixty perished by drowning or crushing.

sentences.zh: 丁未，長溪縣漂民廬二百八十餘家。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Changxi County had more than two hundred eighty civilian dwellings swept away.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, floods at Changxi County swept away more than two hundred eighty households.

sentences.zh: 古田縣漂官舍、民廬甚衆，溺死者二百七十。

translations.literal: Gutian County had very many official quarters and civilian dwellings swept away; two hundred seventy drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Gutian County lost a great many government buildings and homes to the flood; two hundred seventy drowned.

sentences.zh: 劍浦縣圮二百五十余家，死者亦衆。

translations.literal: Jianpu County had more than two hundred fifty households collapse; the dead were also very numerous.
translations.idiomatic: More than two hundred fifty households collapsed at Jianpu County, and casualties were likewise heavy.

sentences.zh: 三年四月，江南郡邑水害稼。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year, commanderies and towns south of the Yangtze had flooding that harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year, floods in Jiangnan towns and prefectures damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 嘉定二年五月己亥，連州大水，敗城郭百餘丈，沒官舍、郡庠、民廬，壞田畝聚落甚多。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Jiading, on the day jihai, Lianzhou had great flooding; more than one hundred zhang of city walls were breached; official quarters, the prefectural school, and civilian dwellings were submerged; very many fields, mu, and settlements were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the fifth month of the second year of Jiading, Lianzhou was deluged, breaching more than one hundred zhang of wall, submerging government buildings, the prefectural school, and homes, and ruining vast tracts of farmland and settlements.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，西和州水，沒長道縣治、倉庫。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day xinyou, Xihe prefecture had flooding that submerged the Changdao county seat and storehouses.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the sixth month, floods at Xihe prefecture submerged the Changdao county seat and its storehouses.

sentences.zh: 丙子，昭化縣水，沒縣治，漂民廬。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Zhaohua County had flooding that submerged the county seat and swept away civilian dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, flooding at Zhaohua County submerged the county seat and swept away homes.

sentences.zh: 成州水，入城，圮壘舍。

translations.literal: Chengzhou had flooding that entered the city; stockade buildings collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Floods at Chengzhou poured into the city and collapsed the barracks.

sentences.zh: 同谷縣及遂寧府、閬州皆水。

translations.literal: Tonggu County and Suining Prefecture and Langzhou all had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Tonggu County, Suining Prefecture, and Langzhou all flooded.

sentences.zh: 七月壬辰，台州大風雨激海濤，漂圮二千二百八十餘家，溺死尤衆。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the day renchen, Taizhou had great wind and rain that drove sea waves; more than two thousand two hundred eighty households were swept away or collapsed; drowning deaths were especially numerous.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the seventh month, wind and rain at Taizhou drove the sea inland, destroying more than two thousand two hundred eighty households; drowning casualties were especially heavy.

sentences.zh: 三年四月甲子，新城縣大水。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year, on the day jiazi, Xincheng County had great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the fourth month of the third year, Xincheng County was severely flooded.

sentences.zh: 五月，嚴、衢、婺徽州、富陽、余杭、鹽官、新城、諸暨、淳安大雨水，溺死者衆，圮田廬、市郭，首種皆腐。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Yan, Qu, Wu, Huizhou, Fuyang, Yuhang, Yanguan, Xincheng, Zhuji, and Chun'an had heavy rain and flooding; very many drowned; fields, dwellings, and market towns collapsed; the first sowing all rotted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month torrential rains struck Yan, Qu, Wu, Huizhou, Fuyang, Yuhang, Yanguan, Xincheng, Zhuji, and Chun'an. Many drowned, fields, homes, and market towns collapsed, and the first planting rotted entirely.

sentences.zh: 行都大水，浸廬舍五千三百，禁旅壘舍之在城外者半沒，西湖溢。

translations.literal: The mobile capital had great flooding; five thousand three hundred dwellings were soaked; of the imperial guard stockade buildings outside the city, half were submerged; West Lake overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: The mobile capital was inundated, flooding five thousand three hundred dwellings, submerging half the imperial guard compounds outside the walls, and causing West Lake to overflow.

sentences.zh: 四年七月辛酉，慈溪縣大水，圮田廬，人多溺者。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year, on the day xinyou, Cixi County had great flooding; fields and dwellings collapsed; very many drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the seventh month of the fourth year, severe flooding at Cixi County collapsed fields and homes and drowned many.

sentences.zh: 八月，山陰縣海敗堤，漂民田數十里，斥地十萬畝。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Shanyin County's sea breached the dikes; civilian fields were swept away for several tens of li; one hundred thousand mu of land were salinized.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the sea broke Shanyin County's dikes, sweeping away farmland for miles and salinizing one hundred thousand mu.

sentences.zh: 五年五月庚戌，嚴州水。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year, on the day gengxu, Yanzhou had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the fifth month of the fifth year, Yanzhou flooded.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，台州及建德、諸暨、會稽縣水，壞田廬。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day dingchou, Taizhou and Jiande, Zhuji, and Kuaiji counties had flooding that destroyed fields and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the sixth month, floods at Taizhou and in Jiande, Zhuji, and Kuaiji counties ruined fields and homes.

sentences.zh: 六年六月丁丑，淳安縣山湧暴水，陷清泉寺，漂五鄉田廬百八十里，溺死者無算，巨木皆拔。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the sixth year, on the day dingchou, Chun'an County had mountain torrents and sudden flooding; Qingquan Temple collapsed; fields and dwellings of five townships over one hundred eighty li were swept away; the drowned were beyond counting; great trees were all uprooted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the sixth month of the sixth year, a mountain torrent burst upon Chun'an County, swallowing Qingquan Temple and sweeping away fields and homes across five townships for one hundred eighty li. Casualties were beyond count and great trees were uprooted.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，于潛縣大水。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Yuqian County had great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Yuqian County was severely flooded.

sentences.zh: 戊子，諸暨縣風雷大雨，山湧暴作，漂十鄉田廬，溺死者尤多。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Zhuji County had wind, thunder, and heavy rain; mountain torrents surged forth suddenly; fields and dwellings of ten townships were swept away; drowning deaths were especially numerous.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, wind, thunder, and torrential rain struck Zhuji County as mountain floods burst out, sweeping away ten townships' fields and homes; drowning casualties were especially heavy.

sentences.zh: 錢塘縣、臨安、余杭、于潛、安吉縣皆水。

translations.literal: Qiantang County, Lin'an, Yuhang, Yuqian, and Anji counties all had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Qiantang County, Lin'an, Yuhang, Yuqian, and Anji counties all flooded.

sentences.zh: 九年五月，行都及紹興府、嚴、衢、婺、台、處、信、饒、福、漳、泉州、興化軍大水，漂田廬，害稼。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the ninth year, the mobile capital and Shaoxing Prefecture, Yan, Qu, Wu, Tai, Chu, Xin, Rao, Fu, Zhang, Quan prefectures, and Xinghua Circuit had great flooding; fields and dwellings were swept away; crops were harmed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the ninth year the mobile capital, Shaoxing Prefecture, Yan, Qu, Wu, Tai, Chu, Xin, Rao, Fu, Zhang, and Quan prefectures, and Xinghua Circuit were inundated, sweeping away fields and homes and ruining the crops.

sentences.zh: 十年冬，浙江濤溢，圮廬舍，覆舟，溺死甚衆。

translations.literal: In the winter of the tenth year, the Zhe River's waves overflowed; dwellings collapsed; boats capsized; very many drowned.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the Qiantang bore overflowed, collapsing homes, capsizing boats, and drowning many.

sentences.zh: 蜀、漢二州江沒城郭。

translations.literal: The rivers of Shu and Han prefectures submerged the city walls.
translations.idiomatic: Rivers at Shu and Han prefectures submerged the cities.

sentences.zh: 十一年六月戊申，武康、吉安縣大水，漂官舍、民廬，壞田稼，人畜死者甚衆。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eleventh year, on the day wushen, Wukang and Ji'an counties had great flooding; official quarters and civilian dwellings were swept away; grain crops were destroyed; very many persons and livestock died.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the sixth month of the eleventh year, severe floods at Wukang and Ji'an counties swept away government buildings and homes, ruined the crops, and killed many people and livestock.

sentences.zh: 十二年，鹽官縣海失故道，潮汐沖平野三十餘里，至是侵縣治，廬州港瀆及上下管、黃灣岡等場皆圮。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Yanguan County's sea lost its former course; tides and currents washed level fields for more than thirty li; by this time they encroached on the county seat; Luzhou's harbors and canals and the Shangxia guan, Huangwan gang, and other salt stations all collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year the sea at Yanguan County abandoned its old channel; tides scoured more than thirty li of farmland and now reached the county seat. Harbors and canals at Luzhou and salt stations such as Shangxia guan and Huangwan gang all collapsed.

sentences.zh: 蜀山淪入海中，聚落、田疇失其半，壞四郡田。

translations.literal: Shushan sank into the sea; settlements and fields lost half; fields of four prefectures were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Shushan was swallowed by the sea, settlements and farmland lost half their extent, and crops across four prefectures were ruined.

sentences.zh: 後六年始平。

translations.literal: Only after six years did it become level.
translations.idiomatic: Six years passed before the waters subsided.

sentences.zh: 十四年，建康府大水。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, Jiankang Prefecture had great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year Jiankang Prefecture was severely flooded.

sentences.zh: 十五年七月，蕭山縣大水。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifteenth year, Xiaoshan County had great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifteenth year Xiaoshan County was deluged.

sentences.zh: 時久雨，衢、婺、徽、嚴暴流與江濤合，圮田廬，害稼。

translations.literal: At that time there was prolonged rain; violent torrents of Qu, Wu, Hui, and Yan combined with the Yangtze's waves; fields and dwellings collapsed; crops were harmed.
translations.idiomatic: Prolonged rains sent flash floods from Qu, Wu, Hui, and Yan to meet the Yangtze surge, collapsing fields and homes and ruining the harvest.

sentences.zh: 十六年五月，江、浙、淮、荊、蜀郡縣水，平江府、湖、常、秀、池、鄂、楚、太平州、廣德軍爲甚，漂民廬，害稼，圮城郭、堤防，溺死者衆。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the sixteenth year, commanderies and counties of Jiang, Zhe, Huai, Jing, and Shu had flooding; Pingjiang Prefecture, Hu, Chang, Xiu, Chi, E, Chu, Taiping prefecture, and Guangde Circuit were especially severe; civilian dwellings were swept away; crops were harmed; city walls and dikes collapsed; very many drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the sixteenth year floods struck Jiang, Zhe, Huai, Jing, and Shu, worst at Pingjiang Prefecture, Huzhou, Changzhou, Xiuzhou, Chizhou, Ezhou, Chuzhou, Taiping, and Guangde Circuit. Homes were swept away, crops ruined, walls and dikes collapsed, and drowning casualties were heavy.

sentences.zh: 鄂州江湖合漲，城市沉沒，累月不泄。

translations.literal: Ezhou's rivers and lakes rose together; the city was submerged; for many months it did not drain.
translations.idiomatic: At Ezhou rivers and lakes rose together, submerging the city, which did not drain for months.

sentences.zh: 是秋，江溢，圮民廬。

translations.literal: That autumn, the river overflowed; civilian dwellings collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the river overflowed and homes collapsed.

sentences.zh: 余杭、錢塘、仁和縣大水。

translations.literal: Yuhang, Qiantang, and Renhe counties had great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Yuhang, Qiantang, and Renhe counties were severely flooded.

sentences.zh: 福、漳、泉州、興化軍水壞稼十五六。

translations.literal: Fu, Zhang, Quan prefectures and Xinghua Circuit had flooding that destroyed fifteen or sixteen tenths of the crops.
translations.idiomatic: Floods at Fu, Zhang, and Quan prefectures and Xinghua Circuit ruined fifteen or sixteen tenths of the harvest.

sentences.zh: 十七年五月，福建大水，漂水口鎮民廬皆盡，候官縣甘蔗砦漂數百家，人多溺死；

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the seventeenth year, Fujian had great flooding; civilian dwellings of Shuikou town were all swept away; in Houguan County more than several hundred households of Ganzhe stockade were swept away; very many drowned;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the seventeenth year severe floods struck Fujian, wiping out Shuikou town and sweeping away several hundred households at Ganzhe stockade in Houguan County; many drowned;

sentences.zh: 建甯府沒平政橋，入城；

translations.literal: Jianning Prefecture submerged Pingzheng Bridge and entered the city;
translations.idiomatic: waters submerged Pingzheng Bridge and poured into Jianning city;

sentences.zh: 南劍州圮郡治、城樓、郡獄、官舍，城壞，民避水樓上者皆死。

translations.literal: Nanjian prefecture had the prefectural seat, city tower, prefectural prison, and official quarters collapse; the city was destroyed; civilians who took refuge from the water on upper stories all died.
translations.idiomatic: At Nanjian the prefectural seat, gate tower, prison, and government buildings collapsed and the city was ruined; everyone who fled upstairs to escape the flood perished.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，建昌軍大水，城不沒者三板，漂民廬，圮官舍、城郭、橋樑，害稼。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, Jianchang Circuit had great flooding; of the city only three plank layers were not submerged; civilian dwellings were swept away; official quarters, city walls, and bridges collapsed; crops were harmed.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Jianchang Circuit was inundated until only three plank courses of the wall stood above water. Homes were swept away, government buildings, walls, and bridges collapsed, and crops were ruined.

sentences.zh: 紹定二年，天臺、仙居縣大水。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shaoding, Tiantai and Xianju counties had great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shaoding, Tiantai and Xianju counties were severely flooded.

sentences.zh: 四年，沿江水災。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, there were flood disasters along the river.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year floods struck along the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 端平三年三月辛酉，蘄州大雨水，漂民居。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year of Duanping, on the day xinyou, Qizhou had heavy rain and flooding; civilian dwellings were swept away.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the third month of the third year of Duanping, torrential rains at Qizhou swept away homes.

sentences.zh: 是年，英德府、昭州及襄、漢江皆大水。

translations.literal: That year, Yingde Prefecture, Shaozhou, and the Xiang and Han rivers all had great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That year Yingde Prefecture, Shaozhou, and the Xiang and Han rivers were all severely flooded.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙元年，饒、信州水。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaxi, Rao and Xin prefectures had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiaxi, Rao and Xin prefectures flooded.

sentences.zh: 二年，浙江溢。

translations.literal: In the second year, the Zhe River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the Qiantang bore overflowed.

sentences.zh: 淳祐二年，紹興府、處、婺州水。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chunyou, Shaoxing Prefecture, Chu, and Wu prefectures had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chunyou, Shaoxing Prefecture, Chuzhou, and Wuzhou flooded.

sentences.zh: 七年，福建水。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Fujian had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Fujian flooded.

sentences.zh: 十年，嚴州水。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Yanzhou had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Yanzhou flooded.

sentences.zh: 十一年八月甲辰，汀州山水暴至，漂人民。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the eleventh year, on the day jiachen, Tingzhou's mountain waters arrived suddenly; people were swept away.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the eighth month of the eleventh year, a mountain torrent burst upon Tingzhou and swept people away.

sentences.zh: 九月，江陵水。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Jiangling had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Jiangling flooded.

sentences.zh: 是年，江、浙多水，饒州亦水。

translations.literal: That year, Jiang and Zhe had much flooding; Raozhou also had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That year floods were widespread in Jiang and Zhe; Raozhou flooded as well.

sentences.zh: 十二年六月，建甯府、嚴、衢、婺、信、台、處、南劍州、邵武軍大水，冒城郭，漂室廬，死者以萬數。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twelfth year, Jianning Prefecture, Yan, Qu, Wu, Xin, Tai, Chu, Nanjian prefecture, and Shaowu Circuit had great flooding; it overtopped city walls; dwellings were swept away; the dead numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twelfth year great floods struck Jianning Prefecture, Yan, Qu, Wu, Xin, Tai, Chu, Nanjian, and Shaowu Circuit, overtopping walls, sweeping away homes, and killing tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 寶祐元年七月，溫、台、處、信、饒州大水。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Baoyou, Wen, Tai, Chu, Xin, and Rao prefectures had great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of Baoyou (1253), Wen, Tai, Chu, Xin, and Rao prefectures suffered major floods.

sentences.zh: 開慶元年五月己未，婺州水，漂民廬。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei in the fifth month of the first year of Kaiqing, flooding in Wuzhou washed away dwellings of the people.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei in the fifth month of the first year of Kaiqing (1259), floods in Wuzhou swept away people's homes.

sentences.zh: 是歲，滁、嚴州水。

translations.literal: That year, Chu and Yan prefectures had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Chu and Yan prefectures suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 景定二年，浙東水。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingding, eastern Zhejiang had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jingding (1261), eastern Zhejiang suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 鹹淳六年五月，大雨水。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the sixth year of Xianchun, there was great rain and flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the sixth year of Xianchun (1270), heavy rains and flooding struck.

sentences.zh: 七年五月甲申，諸暨縣大水，漂廬舍。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen in the fifth month of the seventh year, great flooding in Zhuji County washed away dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen in the fifth month of the seventh year (1271), major floods in Zhuji County swept away homes.

sentences.zh: 是月，重慶府江水泛溢者三，漂城壁，壞樓櫓。

translations.literal: That month, the river in Chongqing Prefecture overflowed three times, washing away city walls and destroying watchtowers.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the river in Chongqing Prefecture overflowed three times, sweeping away city walls and destroying watchtowers.

sentences.zh: 十年三月，廬州水。

translations.literal: In the third month of the tenth year, Luzhou had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the tenth year (1274), Luzhou suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 四月，紹興府大雨水。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Shaoxing Prefecture had great rain and flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Shaoxing Prefecture suffered heavy rains and flooding.

sentences.zh: 八月，臨安府水，安吉、武康縣水。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Lin'an Prefecture had flooding; Anji and Wukang counties had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Lin'an Prefecture flooded, as did Anji and Wukang counties.

sentences.zh: 太平興國四年八月，滑州黎陽縣河清。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo, the river in Liyang County, Huazhou, ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo (979), the river in Liyang County, Huazhou, ran clear.

sentences.zh: 端拱元年二月，澶、濮二州河清二百餘里。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Duangong, the rivers in Chan and Pu prefectures ran clear for more than two hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Duangong (988), the rivers in Chan and Pu prefectures ran clear for more than two hundred li.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符三年十一月丁酉，陝西河清。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou in the eleventh month of the third year of Dazhong Xiangfu, the river in Shaanxi ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou in the eleventh month of the third year of Dazhong Xiangfu (1010), the river in Shaanxi ran clear.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳，河再清，當汾水合流處清如汾水。

translations.literal: On the day yisi in the twelfth month, the river ran clear again; at the place where it joins the Fen River it was as clear as the Fen.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi in the twelfth month, the river ran clear again; where it meets the Fen River it was as clear as the Fen itself.

sentences.zh: 元豐四年十月，環州河水變甘。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year of Yuanfeng, the river water in Huanzhou turned sweet.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fourth year of Yuanfeng (1081), the river water in Huanzhou turned sweet.

sentences.zh: 大觀元年八月，乾寧軍河清。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Daguan, the river in Qianning Army ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Daguan (1107), the river in Qianning Army ran clear.

sentences.zh: 二年十二月，陝州河清，同州韓城縣、郃陽縣至清及百里，涉春不變。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the second year, the river in Shanzhou ran clear; in Hancheng and Heyang counties, Tongzhou, the clear stretch reached a hundred li and lasted through spring without change.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the second year (1108), the river in Shanzhou ran clear; in Hancheng and Heyang counties in Tongzhou the clear stretch extended a hundred li and persisted unchanged through spring.

sentences.zh: 自是迄政和、宣和，諸路數奏河清，輒遣郎官致祭，宰臣等率百官拜表賀，歲以爲常。

translations.literal: From this until the Zhenghe and Xuanhe eras, the various circuits repeatedly reported that the river had run clear; each time a court gentleman was sent to offer sacrifice, and the chief ministers led the hundred officials in memorializing congratulations—year by year it became routine.
translations.idiomatic: From then until the Zhenghe and Xuanhe reigns, circuits repeatedly reported a clear river; each time a court gentleman was dispatched to offer sacrifice, and the chief ministers led the officials in congratulatory memorials—until it became an annual routine.

sentences.zh: 熙寧元年五月，京師開化坊醴泉出。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Xining, a sweet spring appeared in Kaihua ward in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of Xining (1068), a sweet spring appeared in Kaihua ward in the capital.

sentences.zh: 政和五年正月，河陽臺觀醴泉出。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year of Zhenghe, a sweet spring appeared at the terrace-shrine in Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year of Zhenghe (1115), a sweet spring appeared at the terrace-shrine in Heyang.
